Chapter 2. Model Data模型数据

One of the most fundamental challenges when running LLMs on Kubernetes is managing the sheer size of the model data. LLMs can range from a few gigabytes to nearly a terabyte in size, and efficiently bringing this data into a cluster where runtimes can access it requires careful consideration.

在 Kubernetes 上运行 LLM 时，最根本的挑战之一就是模型数据的巨大体量。LLM 小则数 GB、大则接近 1 TB，要把这些数据高效地送进集群、让运行时能够访问，需要仔细权衡。

The main portion of those models consists of the model parameters and can be extremely large. Table 2-1 lists the number of parameters and size of some more prominent available models that you can run yourself. There are many more, but from this selection you can already see a wide range of variations. These range from large models that are likely impractical for on-demand use, to more lightweight models that can be run on your own cluster and easily downloaded when needed.

这些模型的主体是模型参数，体积可以非常庞大。表 2-1 列出了一些你可以自行运行的较知名模型的参数量与体积。可用的模型远不止这些，但仅从这一列表就能看出差异范围之广：既有大到几乎无法按需使用的巨型模型，也有更轻量、可跑在自有集群上、需要时随手下载的模型。

Even smaller models can pose significant challenges for Kubernetes administrators when managing them efficiently within a cluster. Understanding how to store and organize these large datasets effectively is critical for a successful LLM operation.

即便小一些的模型，在集群内高效管理时也会给 Kubernetes 管理员带来不小的挑战。理解如何有效存储与组织这些大数据集，是 LLM 运维成功的关键。

In this chapter, we will explore how to manage data-heavy artifacts efficiently within a Kubernetes cluster. Most of the time, ML models can be treated as opaque boxes, accessed by the inference services described in Chapter 1. However, understanding the package formats used to distribute these models is still valuable for successful integration. The next section provides an overview of the most important LLM storage formats.

本章探讨如何在 Kubernetes 集群内高效管理数据密集型制品。大多数时候，ML 模型可以当作黑盒，由第 1 章介绍的推理服务来访问；但理解这些模型分发所用的打包格式，对成功集仍然很有价值。下一节概览最重要的几种 LLM 存储格式。

Another critical aspect of operating LLMs is discovering where to find and how to retrieve model data. The concept of model registries, discussed in “Model Registry” on page 46, offers a practical solution for model discovery and access.

运维 LLM 的另一个关键方面是：去哪里找、以及如何取回模型数据。模型注册表（model registry）这一概念在第 46 页“模型注册表”一节讨论，为模型发现与访问提供了一套实用方案。

Finally, the models must be downloaded into the cluster to be usable. “Accessing Model Data in Kubernetes” on page 59 outlines Kubernetes-native methods for efficiently fetching and accessing model data.

最后，模型必须下载进集群才能使用。第 59 页“在 Kubernetes 中访问模型数据”一节概述了高效拉取与访问模型数据的 Kubernetes 原生方法。

With this road map in mind, let’s start by examining how LLM data is packaged and stored.

带着这张路线图，我们先来看 LLM 数据是如何打包与存储的。

Model Data Storage Formats
模型数据存储格式

The first thing we notice when working with LLMs is their massive size, measured in billions of parameters. However, models shared on platforms like Hugging Face contain more than just the raw weight parameters. These distributed models also include metadata and, in some cases, the model’s architecture, which defines how the neural network layers and transformers are wired together.

和 LLM 打交道时，第一感受就是它们的巨大体量——动辄数十亿参数。但在 Hugging Face 这类平台上分享的模型，并不只有原始权重参数。这些分发型模型还包含元数据，有时甚至包含模型架构，即定义神经网络各层与 transformer 如何连接在一起。

For operators, such distributed models often feel like black boxes. Yet, understanding which format they are stored in is critical because not every packaged model can run with every runtime, as described in Chapter 1. Some formats are highly flexible and can be operated by multiple runtimes, while others are closely tied to specific runtime platforms.

对运维人员而言，这类分发型模型常常像黑盒。但理解它们以何种格式存储至关重要，因为正如第 1 章所述，并非每个打包好的模型都能在任意运行时上跑。有些格式高度灵活、可被多种运行时操作，另一些则与特定运行时平台紧密绑定。

At a high level, model storage formats can be grouped into two categories:

从高层次看，模型存储格式可分为两大类：

  • Weights-only formats. These formats store only the learned parameters of a neural network: the weights and biases. The architecture, hyperparameters, and metadata are excluded, so the runtime must already know how to reconstruct the network before applying the weights.仅权重格式。这类格式只存储神经网络学到的参数：权重与偏置。架构、超参数和元数据都被排除在外，因此运行时必须事先知道如何重建网络，才能加载权重。
    • 原书第 72 页
  • Self-contained formats. Self-contained formats store both the weights and the model architecture, along with hyperparameters and other metadata. They allow the model to be loaded and run without requiring prior knowledge of the network structure, making them easier to deploy as standalone artifacts.自包含格式。自包含格式同时存储权重与模型架构，以及超参数和其他元数据。它们允许在不预先了解网络结构的情况下加载并运行模型，因此更易作为独立制品部署。

    • The boundary between both categories is gradual. Some formats that seem self-contained may still require external components, such as tokenizer files for language models.

    两类之间的边界是渐进的。有些看似自包含的格式仍可能需要外部组件，例如语言模型所需的 tokenizer 文件。

    For LLMs, the trend is moving toward mostly self-contained formats like GGUF and Safetensors. These formats simplify distribution but remain tightly coupled to specialized runtimes. True runtime independence where a model could be loaded and run in any compatible environment, regardless of the model’s training framework, remains a work in progress. The CNCF ModelPack specification described in “CNCF ModelPack Specification” on page 67 is a standardization attempt in this direction. In this approach, model data is packed in Open Container Initiative (OCI) container images (see “What Is OCI?” on page 57).

    对 LLM 而言，趋势正转向以 GGUF、Safetensors 为代表的“大部分自包含”格式。这些格式简化了分发，但仍与专用运行时紧耦合。真正的运行时无关——即模型无论训练框架如何，都能在任意兼容环境中加载运行——仍在探索中。第 67 页“CNCF ModelPack 规范”一节描述的 CNCF ModelPack 规范正是朝此方向的一次标准化尝试。在这种方式下，模型数据被打包进 OCI（Open Container Initiative）容器镜像（见第 57 页“什么是 OCI？”）。

    In an ideal world, much like OCI container images abstract application internals, model storage formats would draw a clear boundary between model data (produced by data scientists) and model execution (managed by MLOps/DevOps engineers in production). However, today’s landscape prioritizes getting models operational quickly rather than standardizing runtime compatibility. As the field matures, expect stronger separation between model creation and deployment concerns.

    在理想世界里，就像 OCI 容器镜像把应用内部细节抽象掉一样，模型存储格式也应在模型数据（由数据科学家产出）与模型执行（由 MLOps/DevOps 工程师在生产环境管理）之间划出清晰边界。但今天的现状更看重让模型尽快跑起来，而不是标准化运行时兼容性。随着领域成熟，模型创建与部署两方面的关注点会进一步分离。

    Weight-Only Formats
    仅权重格式

    Weight-only model formats store the numerical parameters (weights and biases) of a trained neural network without including the model’s architecture or preprocessing components. These formats are commonly used during the development and experimentation phases, where flexibility and minimal overhead are more important.

    仅权重模型格式存储训练好的神经网络的数值参数（权重与偏置），不包含模型架构或预处理组件。这类格式常用于开发与实验阶段——那时灵活性与最小开销比别的更重要。

    Since weight-only formats lack architectural details, the runtime must already know the network structure. This knowledge allows the runtime to correctly reconstruct the model and apply the stored weights. Weight-only formats are tightly coupled to their respective machine learning frameworks.

    由于仅权重格式缺少架构细节，运行时必须事先知道网络结构。有了这一知识，运行时才能正确重建模型并加载存储的权重。仅权重格式与其对应的机器学习框架紧耦合。

    The most commonly used weight-only formats correspond to the two dominant ML frameworks: PyTorch and TensorFlow. While both frameworks provide their own serialization formats, PyTorch has become the de facto standard for LLM development (see Chapter 6 for more details). Some common weight-only formats used for LLMs and other AI models include:

    最常用的仅权重格式对应两大主流 ML 框架：PyTorch 与 TensorFlow。两者都有自己的序列化格式，而 PyTorch 已成为 LLM 开发的事实标准（详见第 6 章）。LLM 及其他 AI 模型常用的一些仅权重格式包括：

    原书第 73 页
  • PyTorch State Dict (.pt, .pth). PyTorch’s native format for serializing weight tensors using the state_dict method of torch.nn.Module. It is widely used for LLMs such as Llama, GPT, and BLOOM during development and fine-tuning stages.PyTorch State Dict（.pt、.pth）。PyTorch 原生格式，通过 torch.nn.Module 的 state_dict 方法序列化权重张量。在 Llama、GPT、BLOOM 等 LLM 的开发与微调阶段被广泛使用。
  • TensorFlow checkpoints (.ckpt). A format primarily used in TensorFlow’s ecosystem for storing model weights. While it was historically used for models like BERT, its relevance for modern LLMs has declined as PyTorch, which uses its own format, gained dominance in the GenAI space.TensorFlow checkpoints（.ckpt）。主要用于 TensorFlow 生态存储模型权重的格式。历史上曾用于 BERT 等模型，但随着 PyTorch 以自有格式在 GenAI 领域占据主导，它对现代 LLM 的重要性已下降。
  • NumPy arrays (.npy, .npz). NumPy’s native serialization format for numerical arrays. While still useful for storing smaller models or individual weight matrices, it lacks the structure and metadata needed for modern LLM deployments.NumPy 数组（.npy、.npz）。NumPy 原生的数值数组序列化格式。它仍可用于存储较小模型或单个权重矩阵，但缺少现代 LLM 部署所需的结构与元数据。

    • These formats primarily store raw tensor data with minimal metadata, making them highly compact but dependent on external runtime code.

    这些格式主要存储原始张量数据、元数据极少，因此非常紧凑，但依赖外部运行时代码。

    As illustrated in Figure 2-1, a model stored in a weight-only format requires the same network architecture to be reconstructed during inference. You must manually replicate the training architecture in the inference environment, ensuring that both sides can correctly interpret the stored weight tensors.

    如图 2-1 所示，以仅权重格式存储的模型，在推理时必须重建出相同的网络架构。你必须在推理环境中手动复刻训练时的架构，确保两端都能正确解读存储的权重张量。

    原书第 74 页

    While weight-only storage formats are well suited during the development and experimentation phase, they are very closely coupled to the ML code that evaluates those parameters.

    仅权重存储格式虽然很适合开发与实验阶段，但它们与评估这些参数的 ML 代码耦合得非常紧。

    Self-Contained Formats
    自包含格式

    A better fit for production deployments are models stored and distributed in self-contained formats, which bundle more than just the raw weights. These formats include critical metadata and structural information, making models easier to share and run across multiple runtime environments without requiring the original codebase used during training.

    更适合生产部署的是以自包含格式存储与分发的模型——它们打包的不只是原始权重。这些格式包含关键元数据与结构信息，使模型更易于在多种运行时环境间共享与运行，而无需训练时所用的原始代码库。

    Self-contained models can carry the following information:

    自包含模型可携带以下信息：

  • Weights and biases. The numerical parameters of the neural network, which make up the bulk of the model size.权重与偏置。神经网络的数值参数，占据模型体积的绝大部分。
  • Model architecture. Either as a reference to a well-known architecture or described explicitly as a connected graph of layers.模型架构。既可以是对知名架构的引用，也可以显式描述为由各层连接而成的图。
  • Tokenizer and vocabulary data. Often included in language models to preprocess text before inference.Tokenizer 与词表数据。语言模型中常包含，用于推理前对文本做预处理。
  • Hyperparameters. Information like learning rate, batch size, and number of epochs used during training.超参数。如训练时使用的学习率、batch size、训练轮数等信息。
  • Other metadata. Descriptive information such as model origin, authorship, and additional context for model discovery and reproducibility.其他元数据。诸如模型来源、作者信息以及用于模型发现与可复现性的额外上下文等描述性信息。

    • Some self-contained formats also support pre- and post-processing scripts for transforming inputs before inference and converting outputs into a usable form afterward.

    有些自包含格式还支持预处理与后处理脚本，用于在推理前变换输入、在推理后把输出转成可用形式。

    Figure 2-2 illustrates a model stored in a self-contained format, where all components are bundled together, enabling runtime independence from the original training code.

    图 2-2 展示了一个以自包含格式存储的模型——所有组件被打包在一起，使运行时不再依赖原始训练代码。

    原书第 75 页

    While fully self-contained formats aim to encapsulate everything needed for inference, in practice as of 2026, no such format exists. No widely used format today includes all components required for inference—the model weights, tokenizer, vocabulary data, and complete architecture—in a single artifact. As a result, even formats often described as “self-contained” are better categorized as mostly self-contained because they still rely on external components and runtime dependencies. These mostly self-contained formats may bundle the model weights and partial metadata but typically omit critical components like the tokenizer or detailed model architecture, remaining tied to specific inference runtimes or frameworks that “understand” how to interpret the stored data correctly. For example, popular formats like Safetensors and GGUF (which we describe in detail later) include model weights and some metadata but still require external components for complete model inference.

    虽然完全自包含格式旨在把推理所需的一切都封装进去，但截至 2026 年，现实中并不存在这样的格式。今天没有哪个被广泛使用的格式把推理所需的全部组件——模型权重、tokenizer、词表数据、完整架构——都放进单个制品里。因此，即便那些常被称为“自包含”的格式，也更准确地应归为“大部分自包含”，因为它们仍依赖外部组件与运行时依赖。这些“大部分自包含”格式可能打包了模型权重与部分元数据，但通常会省略 tokenizer 或详细模型架构等关键组件，仍与特定的推理运行时或框架绑定——后者“懂得”如何正确解读存储的数据。例如 Safetensors 和 GGUF（后文详述）这类流行格式包含模型权重与一些元数据，但要完成完整的模型推理仍需外部组件。

    Common mostly self-contained formats for LLMs include:

    LLM 常用的大部分自包含格式包括：

  • Safetensors (.safetensors). A mostly self-contained format designed for secure and efficient weight storage, frequently used for LLMs on platforms like Hugging Face. While it improves safety and performance over standard PyTorch weight files, tokenizer information (e.g., tokenizer.json) and model architecture definitions are not embedded, requiring additional files or runtime knowledge to fully reconstruct the model during inference. See “Safetensors” on page 42 for more details.Safetensors（.safetensors）。一种大部分自包含格式，专为安全、高效地存储权重而设计，在 Hugging Face 等平台上常用于 LLM。相比标准 PyTorch 权重文件，它在安全性与性能上都有改进，但并未嵌入 tokenizer 信息（如 tokenizer.json）和模型架构定义，推理时仍需额外文件或运行时知识才能完整重建模型。详见第 42 页“Safetensors”。
    • 原书第 76 页
  • GGUF/GGML (.gguf, .ggml). Specialized self-contained formats optimized for efficient inference with quantized weights, supporting both CPU and GPU execution. They include the model’s weights and basic architecture metadata but remain closely tied to runtimes like llama.cpp and vLLM, which are designed to efficiently handle the quantized structures. GGUF can also store the tokenizer data (like vocabulary data and special tokens). See “GGUF and GGML” on page 44 for more information about GGUF.GGUF/GGML（.gguf、.ggml）。专用自包含格式，针对量化权重的高效推理做了优化，同时支持 CPU 与 GPU 执行。它们包含模型权重与基本架构元数据，但仍与 llama.cpp、vLLM 等运行时紧耦合——这些运行时专为高效处理量化结构而设计。GGUF 还可存储 tokenizer 数据（如词表数据与特殊 token）。关于 GGUF 的更多信息见第 44 页“GGUF 与 GGML”。
  • ONNX (.onnx). A versatile, self-contained format for model interoperability. Often described as self-contained, ONNX stores the model’s weights, architecture, and metadata but lacks critical components like the tokenizer and vocabulary data, which are essential for LLMs. This makes it mostly self-contained, requiring additional files for complete language model inference. See “ONNX” on page 41 for more details.ONNX（.onnx）。一种通用的自包含模型互操作格式。ONNX 常被描述为自包含格式，它存储模型的权重、架构与元数据，但缺少 tokenizer、词表数据等对 LLM 至关重要的组件。这使它只能算大部分自包含，要完成完整的语言模型推理仍需额外文件。详见第 41 页“ONNX”。
  • TensorFlow SavedModel. A fully self-contained, directory-based format that stores weights, architecture, and auxiliary files. While common in TensorFlow ecosystems, it is rarely used for modern LLMs.TensorFlow SavedModel。一种完全自包含、基于目录的格式，存储权重、架构与辅助文件。虽然在 TensorFlow 生态中常见，但现代 LLM 很少使用它。
  • Hugging Face Transformers. The Hugging Face Transformers format is best described as a packaging convention rather than a standalone model format. It organizes models into a directory containing multiple files essential for running language models. This convention typically includes the model’s weights stored in formats like Safetensors (.safetensors) or PyTorch’s state_dict (.bin) along with two key files: tokenizer.json and config.json. These files play a crucial role in ensuring the model can process input data and apply the correct architecture during inference.Hugging Face Transformers。Hugging Face Transformers 格式更准确地说是一种打包约定，而非独立的模型格式。它把模型组织进一个目录，目录中包含运行语言模型所需的多个文件。这一约定通常包括：以 Safetensors（.safetensors）或 PyTorch state_dict（.bin）等格式存储的模型权重，以及两个关键文件——tokenizer.json 与 config.json。这些文件在确保模型能处理输入数据、并在推理时应用正确架构方面起着关键作用。

    • tokenizer.json and config.json

    The tokenizer.json and config.json files are critical components for running LLMs effectively in the Hugging Face ecosystem and beyond. The tokenizer.json file stores the tokenization rules and vocabulary mapping for converting raw text into token IDs. It defines how input text is split into tokens, using techniques like Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), and includes special tokens used for padding, start-of-sequence, and end-of-sequence markers. The config.json file describes the model architecture and hyperparameters, containing information such as the number of layers, attention heads, hidden sizes, and feed-forward dimensions. It often specifies the model type (e.g., llama) and influences how the runtime reconstructs the model graph. Together, these files ensure the model can preprocess input correctly (tokenizer.json) and build the required network structure (config.json). Without them, the runtime cannot properly tokenize input text or load the model architecture for inference.

    tokenizer.json 与 config.json 是在 Hugging Face 生态内外高效运行 LLM 的关键组件。tokenizer.json 存储分词规则与词表映射，用于把原始文本转换成 token ID；它定义了输入文本如何被切分成 token（使用 Byte-Pair Encoding，即 BPE 等技术），并包含用于 padding、序列起始、序列结束标记的特殊 token。config.json 描述模型架构与超参数，包含层数、注意力头数、隐藏维度、前馈维度等信息；它常指定模型类型（如 llama），并影响运行时如何重建模型图。这两个文件合在一起，确保模型能正确预处理输入（tokenizer.json）并构建所需的网络结构（config.json）。缺少它们，运行时就无法正确对输入文本分词，也无法加载模型架构进行推理。

    原书第 77 页

    These files have become de facto standards in the machine learning community, extending their utility beyond the Hugging Face ecosystem. Frameworks and tools outside of Hugging Face often adopt these conventions for model interoperability and consistency.

    这两个文件已成为机器学习社区的事实标准，其用途已超出 Hugging Face 生态。Hugging Face 之外的框架与工具也常采用这些约定，以实现模型互操作与一致性。

    As we have seen, most current model formats for LLMs fall into the category of mostly self-contained, often omitting key components such as tokenizers, vocabulary data, and preprocessing logic. Despite these gaps, some formats have gained significant traction due to their balance between portability and efficiency. The most commonly used for LLM deployments today are Safetensors and GGUF/GGML, both optimized for efficient weight storage with metadata. While ONNX is less frequently used for LLMs, it serves as a useful reference for a more fully self-contained format, though it would require additional elements like tokenizer definitions to be truly complete. In the following sections, we will explore ONNX, Safetensors, and GGUF/GGML in more detail.

    如前所述，当前大多数 LLM 模型格式都属于“大部分自包含”一类，常常省略 tokenizer、词表数据、预处理逻辑等关键组件。尽管存在这些缺口，一些格式凭借在可移植性与效率之间的平衡而获得广泛采用。如今 LLM 部署最常用的是 Safetensors 与 GGUF/GGML，二者都针对带元数据的高效权重存储做了优化。ONNX 在 LLM 中较少使用，但它可作为“更完整自包含格式”的有益参照——不过要真正完整，它还需要 tokenizer 定义等额外元素。下一节我们将更详细地探讨 ONNX、Safetensors 与 GGUF/GGML。

    The Quest for True Model Portability

    The following three sections dive into the technical details of specific model formats. While these details may seem tangential to Kubernetes operations, they address a fundamental operational concern: achieving clear separation between model data and runtime execution.

    接下来三节深入特定模型格式的技术细节。这些细节看似与 Kubernetes 运维关系不大，但它们回应了一个根本性的运维关切：实现模型数据与运行时执行之间的清晰分离。

    The goal is to achieve true model portability, where models can be distributed and executed as self-contained artifacts, much like how Docker revolutionized the deployment of arbitrary software workloads across diverse environments. Reaching this level of portability would require broader standardization across both the model file structure and the runtimes capable of executing them. Ideally, a model stored in a standardized format could be loaded by any compliant runtime. This would eliminate manual adjustments for tokenization, quantization, or architecture specifics. Such a shift would empower a more diverse set of tools and frameworks, reducing lock-in to specific ecosystems while making model distribution as seamless as containerized applications.

    目标是实现真正的模型可移植性：模型能作为自包含制品被分发与执行，就像 Docker 革新了任意软件负载在不同环境间的部署一样。要达到这种可移植性，需要在模型文件结构与可执行它们的运行时两方面都有更广泛的标准化。理想情况下，以标准化格式存储的模型可被任何合规运行时加载，从而免去在分词、量化或架构细节上的手动调整。这种转变将赋能更多样的工具与框架，降低对特定生态的锁定，让模型分发像容器化应用一样顺畅。

    This separation is the holy grail that would let operators treat models as interchangeable artifacts, independent of the runtimes that execute them. We haven’t reached this ideal yet, but examining existing formats reveals how close we are to achieving true runtime-model independence. If you’re more interested in the practical aspects of model discovery and distribution rather than format internals, you can skip ahead to “Model Registry” on page 46, where we discuss model registries.

    这种分离是圣杯——它能让运维人员把模型当作可互换的制品，独立于执行它们的运行时。我们尚未达到这一理想，但考察现有格式可以看出距离真正的“运行时-模型独立”还有多远。如果你更关心模型发现与分发的实践层面、而非格式内部细节，可以直接跳到第 46 页“模型注册表”一节。

    原书第 78 页

    ONNX

    The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX), codeveloped by Microsoft and Facebook in 2017, was designed as a framework-independent format for representing machine learning models. ONNX aims to standardize how models are shared between tools, allowing developers to train a model in one framework and deploy it in another without requiring framework-specific conversions.

    Open Neural Network Exchange（ONNX）由 Microsoft 与 Facebook 于 2017 年联合开发，是一种框架无关的机器学习模型表示格式。ONNX 旨在标准化模型在工具之间的共享方式，让开发者可以在一个框架中训练模型、再部署到另一个框架，而无需做框架专属的转换。

    ONNX models are stored in a single .onnx file using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) for compactness and platform neutrality. Each file contains three main components. First, the computational graph defines the network’s structure and data flow. Second, the learned parameters include weights and biases. Third, metadata describes input/output specifications, operator sets, and versioning details. This structure makes ONNX a promising example of a self-contained format, as it combines architecture, weights, and operational metadata in a single artifact.

    ONNX 模型存储在单个 .onnx 文件中，使用 Protocol Buffers（Protobuf）编码以获得紧凑性与平台中立性。每个文件包含三个主要部分：第一，计算图定义网络结构与数据流；第二，学到的参数包括权重与偏置；第三，元数据描述输入/输出规格、算子集与版本细节。这种结构使 ONNX 成为自包含格式的一个有希望的范例——它把架构、权重与运维元数据组合进单个制品。

    However, ONNX falls short for LLMs because it lacks essential components such as tokenizers, vocabulary data, and preprocessing logic. For tasks like natural language generation, this missing information makes supplying additional files alongside the .onnx model necessary. Without these components, an ONNX model alone cannot transform raw text into tokenized inputs, limiting its suitability for modern LLM deployments. This gap prevents it from being fully self-contained in the context of language models.

    然而，ONNX 在 LLM 面前有所欠缺，因为它缺少 tokenizer、词表数据、预处理逻辑等关键组件。对于自然语言生成这类任务，这些缺失的信息使得必须在 .onnx 模型之外额外提供文件。没有这些组件，单独一个 ONNX 模型无法把原始文本转成分词后的输入，限制了它在现代 LLM 部署中的适用性。这一缺口使它在语言模型语境下无法做到完全自包含。

    ONNX’s broad support across runtimes like ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO, and Triton Inference Server makes it highly portable, but compatibility depends on the set of operations (such as matrix multiplication, convolution, and attention mechanisms) that a model uses. Each runtime supports a defined operator set (op set), which specifies the available operations a model can use. If a model relies on operations outside a runtime’s supported set, it may fail to load unless extended with plug-ins or custom runtime extensions. This challenge further complicates its adoption for complex architectures like those used in LLMs, where tokenization and text preprocessing steps are integral parts of the model’s functionality.

    ONNX 在 ONNX Runtime、TensorRT、OpenVINO、Triton Inference Server 等多种运行时上的广泛支持使其高度可移植，但兼容性取决于模型所用的算子集合（如矩阵乘法、卷积、注意力机制）。每个运行时支持一个定义好的算子集（op set），规定模型可用的算子。如果模型依赖某运行时支持集之外的算子，就可能加载失败——除非通过插件或自定义运行时扩展来扩展。这一挑战进一步增加了它在 LLM 这类复杂架构中落地的难度，因为 LLM 的分词与文本预处理步骤本身就是模型功能不可分割的一部分。

    Despite these limitations, ONNX provides a conceptual blueprint for what a fully self-contained model format for LLMs could look like. If expanded with richer metadata and native support for tokenizer definitions, it could offer a more complete solution for the LLM use case. As of 2026, ONNX remains better suited for models in domains like computer vision, where preprocessing is often simpler and less tightly coupled with the model.

    尽管存在这些局限，ONNX 仍为“面向 LLM 的完全自包含模型格式”提供了一份概念蓝图。如果能扩充更丰富的元数据、并原生支持 tokenizer 定义，它就能为 LLM 场景提供更完整的解决方案。截至 2026 年，ONNX 仍更适合计算机视觉等领域的模型——那里的预处理通常更简单，与模型的耦合也更松。

    Next, we’ll explore Safetensors, a format more commonly used for LLM deployment today, offering optimized weight handling and some degree of metadata inclusion.

    接下来我们探讨 Safetensors——一种如今在 LLM 部署中更常用的格式，它提供了优化的权重处理，并包含一定程度的元数据。

    原书第 79 页

    Safetensors

    Safetensors, developed by Hugging Face in 2021, is a modern model serialization format designed to securely store and share machine learning model weights while addressing security vulnerabilities and performance limitations of earlier formats like PyTorch’s .pt and pickle. The pickle format, often used in PyTorch, can execute arbitrary Python code when deserializing models, posing significant security risks when sharing models. In contrast, Safetensors prevents code execution vulnerabilities by focusing strictly on storing tensor data, making it a safer and more efficient choice for model serialization.

    Safetensors 由 Hugging Face 于 2021 年开发，是一种现代模型序列化格式，旨在安全地存储与共享机器学习模型权重，同时解决 PyTorch .pt 与 pickle 等早期格式的安全漏洞与性能局限。pickle 格式在 PyTorch 中常用，但反序列化模型时可执行任意 Python 代码，在共享模型时带来显著安全风险。相比之下，Safetensors 严格只存储张量数据，从而杜绝代码执行漏洞，成为更安全、更高效的模型序列化选择。

    Safetensors files follow a simple yet efficient structure, as shown in Figure 2-3.

    Safetensors 文件遵循一种简单而高效的结构，如图 2-3 所示。

    Each .safetensors file begins with a header containing metadata, including a serialized JSON object describing each tensor stored in the file. The header includes details such as the tensor’s data type, shape, and the byte offsets where the tensor data resides within the file. This structure allows for zero-copy loading, where tensor data can be directly mapped to memory without unnecessary CPU overhead, improving inference speed, especially when working with LLMs.

    每个 .safetensors 文件都以一个包含元数据的 header 开头，其中有一个序列化的 JSON 对象，描述文件中存储的每个张量。header 包含张量的数据类型、形状、以及张量数据在文件中的字节偏移等细节。这种结构支持零拷贝加载——张量数据可直接映射到内存，无需多余的 CPU 开销，从而提升推理速度，尤其在处理 LLM 时。

    Safetensors supports sharding, which allows large models to be split across multiple smaller files. Each shard contains a portion of the model’s tensors and is accompanied by an index file (e.g., model.safetensors.index.json). The index file maps the names of tensors in the different layers to their respective shard files. For example, Llama 4.1

    Safetensors 支持分片（sharding），可把大模型拆分到多个较小文件中。每个分片包含模型张量的一部分，并配有一个索引文件（如 model.safetensors.index.json）。索引文件把各层张量的名字映射到它们所在的分片文件。例如，Llama 4.1

    Sharding is particularly useful for extremely large models where a single file might be impractical due to storage limitations. This approach also enables parallel loading, as different shards can be fetched and processed concurrently.

    分片对于超大模型尤其有用——单文件可能因存储限制而不切实际。这种方式还支持并行加载，因为不同分片可被并发拉取与处理。

    While Safetensors improves the safety and performance of model weight storage, it still falls into the category of mostly self-contained formats rather than fully self-contained. The primary limitation is that tokenizer information and model architecture definitions are not included within the .safetensors file itself. Essential files like tokenizer.json and config.json must be supplied separately for language model inference, which is a key reason why it remains tightly coupled to the Hugging Face Transformers ecosystem that provides this extra metadata.

    虽然 Safetensors 改进了模型权重存储的安全性与性能，它仍属于“大部分自包含”而非完全自包含类别。主要局限在于：tokenizer 信息与模型架构定义并不包含在 .safetensors 文件本身之内。语言模型推理所必需的 tokenizer.json、config.json 等文件必须另行提供——这正是它仍与提供这些额外元数据的 Hugging Face Transformers 生态紧耦合的关键原因。

    原书第 81 页

    The format’s structure and focus on secure serialization have made it increasingly popular, especially for LLM storage and sharing. Safetensors is now the default weight format for many large-scale models distributed on Hugging Face.

    该格式的结构与对安全序列化的专注使其日益流行，尤其是在 LLM 存储与共享方面。如今 Safetensors 已是 Hugging Face 上许多大规模模型的默认权重格式。

    Next, we will explore GGUF, a more specialized format for LLMs that is optimized for CPU-based inference and designed for efficient deployment of LLMs.

    接下来我们探讨 GGUF——一种更专用的 LLM 格式，针对基于 CPU 的推理做了优化，专为高效部署 LLM 而设计。

    GGUF and GGML

    The GPT-Generated Unified Format (GGUF) and its predecessor GPT-Generated Model Language (GGML) are specialized formats developed for optimizing the storage and execution of LLMs on resource-constrained hardware such as CPUs and edge devices. Originating from the llama.cpp project led by Georgi Gerganov, both formats focus on efficient inference with minimal hardware requirements. While GGML was an important first step, GGUF represents a significant refinement, addressing many of its predecessor’s limitations.

    GPT-Generated Unified Format（GGUF）及其前身 GPT-Generated Model Language（GGML）是两种专用格式，专为在 CPU、边缘设备等资源受限硬件上优化 LLM 的存储与执行而开发。两者都源自 Georgi Gerganov 主导的 llama.cpp 项目，聚焦于以最小硬件需求实现高效推理。GGML 是重要的第一步，而 GGUF 则是一次重大改进，解决了前者的诸多局限。

    A defining feature of GGUF and GGML is their focus on quantization, a technique that reduces the precision of model weights from floating-point values to lower-bit representations such as 8-bit, 4-bit, or even 2-bit integers. By lowering precision, both the memory footprint and computational overhead are significantly reduced. This allows models to run effectively without dedicated GPUs while maintaining acceptable inference accuracy.

    GGUF 与 GGML 的一个标志性特征是对量化（quantization）的专注——这一技术把模型权重的精度从浮点值降低到 8 位、4 位甚至 2 位整数等低位宽表示。通过降低精度，内存占用与计算开销都大幅下降，从而让模型在没有专用 GPU 的情况下也能有效运行，同时保持可接受的推理精度。

    A key improvement in GGUF is its focus on backward compatibility. As LLMs evolve and their architectures become more complex, maintaining compatibility with existing tools can be challenging. GGUF’s modular design allows newer models to retain compatibility with older runtime versions, provided the core components remain unchanged. This helps prevent the need for frequent format conversions when updating models. The backward compatibility design also minimizes the impact of transitions between versions. When GGUF is updated to support new features, existing models remain functional without requiring conversion.

    GGUF 的一项关键改进是对向后兼容的重视。随着 LLM 演进、架构日趋复杂，与现有工具保持兼容可能颇具挑战。GGUF 的模块化设计让较新的模型只要核心组件不变，就能与较旧的运行时版本保持兼容，从而避免在更新模型时频繁做格式转换。这种向后兼容设计还把版本间迁移的影响降到最低。当 GGUF 升级以支持新特性时，现有模型仍可正常工作，无需转换。

    Unlike ONNX, which was designed as a general-purpose format for a wide range of machine learning tasks, GGUF is specialized for LLM inference. While originally designed for CPU-based inference, GGUF is now widely supported across both CPU and GPU execution by runtimes like llama.cpp and vLLM.

    与作为通用格式、面向广泛机器学习任务而设计的 ONNX 不同，GGUF 专为 LLM 推理而专用。虽然最初为基于 CPU 的推理而设计，如今 GGUF 已被 llama.cpp、vLLM 等运行时广泛支持，可同时在 CPU 与 GPU 上执行。

    When compared to Safetensors, GGUF attempts to bundle more metadata directly within the model file itself, including basic tokenizer information and runtime metadata. While Safetensors focuses primarily on weight storage with minimal metadata and relies on external files for tokenizer definitions and model configurations, GGUF stores token mappings and model parameters in a single file. GGUF still depends on specific external runtimes for complete inference, keeping it in the category of mostly self-contained formats.

    与 Safetensors 相比，GGUF 试图把更多元数据直接打包进模型文件本身，包括基本的 tokenizer 信息与运行时元数据。Safetensors 主要聚焦权重存储、元数据极少，tokenizer 定义与模型配置依赖外部文件；而 GGUF 把 token 映射与模型参数存进单个文件。不过 GGUF 要完成完整推理仍依赖特定外部运行时，因此仍属于“大部分自包含”格式类别。

    原书第 82 页

    A GGUF file consists of a structured binary layout. It begins with a magic number and version field to identify the file type. This is followed by a section containing quantized tensor data stored with byte offsets for efficient access. The metadata section describes the model’s architecture, quantization type, and token mappings. The tensor information block defines the data type, shape, and memory locations for each tensor stored in the file. This single-file design is particularly beneficial in Kubernetes environments, where consistent, self-contained artifacts simplify orchestration and scaling. Figure 2-4 illustrates the structure of a GGUF file.

    GGUF 文件由结构化的二进制布局组成。它以一个魔数（magic number）和版本字段开头，用于标识文件类型；其后是一段存储量化张量数据的区域，数据带字节偏移以便高效访问；元数据段描述模型架构、量化类型与 token 映射；张量信息块定义文件中每个张量的数据类型、形状与内存位置。这种单文件设计在 Kubernetes 环境中尤其有益——一致、自包含的制品能简化编排与扩缩。图 2-4 展示了 GGUF 文件的结构。

    GGUF represents a leap forward for deploying LLMs efficiently, especially on hardware that lacks high-end GPUs. Its focus on quantization, self-contained design, and backward compatibility addresses many pain points of earlier formats.

    GGUF 是高效部署 LLM 道路上的一次飞跃，尤其是在缺乏高端 GPU 的硬件上。它对量化的专注、自包含设计与向后兼容，解决了早期格式的诸多痛点。

    Current State and Gaps
    现状与缺口

    While ONNX stands out as a self-contained format for general machine learning models, and GGUF offers a specialized, self-contained solution for LLMs, both formats reveal important gaps in model portability. ONNX provides a structured way to package models but lacks critical components like tokenizers for LLMs, while GGUF

    ONNX 作为通用机器学习模型的自包含格式独树一帜，GGUF 则为 LLM 提供了专用的自包含方案，但两者都暴露了模型可移植性上的重要缺口。ONNX 提供了结构化打包模型的方式，但缺少 LLM 所需的 tokenizer 等关键组件；而 GGUF

    原书第 83 页

    includes basic tokenizer metadata but remains tightly coupled to specific runtimes like llama.cpp.

    虽然包含基本的 tokenizer 元数据，但仍与 llama.cpp 等特定运行时紧耦合。

    The landscape of LLM development is still evolving rapidly. New architectures, optimization techniques, and runtime improvements emerge frequently. Each introduces specialized configurations that challenge the idea of a universal standard. Until the field matures, mostly self-contained formats like GGUF and Safetensors will likely remain the most practical choices for balancing performance, compatibility, and flexibility. True standardization, much like OCI’s success with containers, will require the convergence of both runtime capabilities and model representation standards, a milestone that is still some distance away. While GGUF dominates the llama.cpp ecosystem, Safetensors is increasingly adopted for production deployments. Its multifile structure works well with OCI artifacts, where model components can be distributed as separate layers for efficient caching and parallel downloads.

    LLM 开发现状仍在快速演进。新架构、优化技术与运行时改进层出不穷，每一种都带来专用配置，挑战着“通用标准”的设想。在领域成熟之前，GGUF、Safetensors 这类“大部分自包含”格式很可能仍是平衡性能、兼容性与灵活性的最实用选择。真正的标准化——就像 OCI 在容器上的成功那样——需要运行时能力与模型表示标准二者汇聚，这一里程碑仍有一段距离。GGUF 在 llama.cpp 生态中占主导，而 Safetensors 正越来越多地被生产部署采用。它的多文件结构与 OCI artifacts 配合良好——模型组件可作为独立层分发，以便高效缓存与并行下载。

    Understanding the structure and formats of model files helps in selecting the right tools and runtimes, but ultimately, an LLM is just a collection of files, whether fully self-contained or spread across multiple artifacts. Managing these files effectively in Kubernetes environments requires a way to index, discover, and organize them, which is the role of a model registry that we talk about next.

    理解模型文件的结构与格式有助于选择合适的工具与运行时，但归根结底，无论完全自包含还是分散在多个制品中，一个 LLM 就是一堆文件。要在 Kubernetes 环境中有效管理这些文件，就需要一种索引、发现与组织它们的方式——这正是模型注册表的职责，下面我们就来讨论。

    Model Registry
    模型注册表

    A model registry provides a central system for managing models, tracking versions, governance, and storing metadata about ML artifacts. It plays a crucial role in the machine learning lifecycle by bridging the gap between model experimentation and production deployment. Serving as both a discovery mechanism and a collaboration platform, a model registry simplifies how models are tracked, verified, and deployed at scale.

    模型注册表提供一个中央系统，用于管理模型、追踪版本、治理以及存储 ML 制品的元数据。它在机器学习生命周期中扮演关键角色，弥合模型实验与生产部署之间的鸿沟。模型注册表既是发现机制，也是协作平台，简化了大规模下模型的追踪、验证与部署。

    Unlike public registries, organizations deploy most model registries as local services within a cluster. Organizations don’t expose these registries outside the cluster. The registries primarily manage model metadata rather than storing the actual model weights or artifacts. Instead, they reference external object stores like AWS S3 buckets where the actual model data resides. This separation of metadata and model storage ensures greater flexibility in managing large models while keeping metadata easily accessible within the cluster.

    与公共注册表不同，大多数模型注册表由组织作为集群内的本地服务部署，并不暴露到集群之外。注册表主要管理模型元数据，而非存储真实的模型权重或制品；它们转而引用外部对象存储（如 AWS S3 桶）——真实模型数据就存放在那里。这种元数据与模型存储的分离，在管理大模型时提供了更大灵活性，同时让元数据在集群内易于访问。

    By providing a structured and secure interface for managing models and their metadata, model registries become a critical tool for operationalizing machine learning at scale, especially in dynamic environments like Kubernetes.

    通过为管理模型及其元数据提供结构化、安全的接口，模型注册表成为大规模落地机器学习的关键工具，在 Kubernetes 这类动态环境中尤其如此。

    A model registry stands at the intersection of the responsibilities of data scientists and MLOps engineers. For data scientists, it supports creating and tracking changes during model experimentation, verifying performance and metric tracking,

    模型注册表处于数据科学家与 MLOps 工程师职责的交汇处。对数据科学家而言，它支持在模型实验期间创建与追踪变更、验证性能与指标追踪、

    原书第 84 页

    packaging artifacts for reproducibility, and releasing validated models to production. For MLOps engineers, the model registry facilitates deploying approved models with associated metadata while also supporting ongoing monitoring of deployed models for performance, drift, and necessary retraining, though this level of observability is considered an advanced feature beyond the core functionality of a model registry.

    为可复现性打包制品，并把验证过的模型发布到生产。对 MLOps 工程师而言，模型注册表便于把已批准的模型连同相关元数据一起部署，同时支持对已部署模型做持续监控（性能、漂移、必要时重训练）——不过这种程度的可观测性被视为超出模型注册表核心功能的高级特性。

    For context on the ML terms model experimentation and feature stores mentioned in this section, see the next sidebar.

    关于本节提到的“模型实验”与“特征存储”这两个 ML 术语，见下面的侧栏。

    Model Experimentation and Feature Stores

    Model experimentation refers to the iterative process of training multiple model variations with different hyperparameters (settings like learning rate or batch size) to find the best-performing configuration. Each training run produces metrics like accuracy or loss. From a Kubernetes perspective, this typically runs as GPU-intensive training jobs covered in Chapters 6 and 7. Experiment tracking systems log parameters and metrics from these runs. MLflow (covered later in this chapter) provides experiment tracking as part of its broader toolset.

    模型实验指的是用不同超参数（如学习率、batch size 等设置）训练多个模型变体、以找到最佳表现配置的迭代过程。每次训练运行都会产生准确率、损失等指标。从 Kubernetes 视角看，这通常表现为 GPU 密集型训练作业，第 6、7 章会讨论。实验追踪系统会记录这些运行的参数与指标。MLflow（本章后文介绍）把实验追踪作为其更广泛工具集的一部分。

    Features in machine learning are input variables that models use to make predictions—for example, “number of transactions in the last hour” or “average amount over 30 days” in a fraud detection system. A feature store manages the computation and serving of these features consistently across training and inference, preventing training-serving skew. Feature computation often runs as data pipelines, as discussed in Chapter 8. For generative AI workloads, features are less central than in traditional ML, as LLMs work primarily with text and embeddings rather than structured features. Feast is a leading open source feature store that manages both traditional ML features and text embeddings for generative AI applications like retrieval-augmented generation (see “Retrieval-Augmented Generation” on page 274).

    机器学习中的特征是模型用来做预测的输入变量——例如欺诈检测系统中“过去一小时的交易笔数”或“30 天平均金额”。特征存储（feature store）在训练与推理之间一致地管理这些特征的计算与服务，防止训练-服务偏斜（training-serving skew）。特征计算通常以数据管道形式运行，第 8 章会讨论。对生成式 AI 负载而言，特征不如传统 ML 那样核心，因为 LLM 主要处理文本与嵌入，而非结构化特征。Feast 是领先的开源特征存储，同时管理传统 ML 特征与面向检索增强生成（RAG，见第 274 页“检索增强生成”）等生成式 AI 应用的文本嵌入。

    Both concepts highlight the collaborative ML workflow: data scientists experiment and iterate, while platform teams provide the Kubernetes infrastructure (GPU nodes, persistent storage, batch scheduling) that makes this work scalable. The model registry serves as the handoff point, storing metadata from successful experiments ready for production deployment.

    这两个概念都凸显了协作式 ML 工作流：数据科学家做实验、迭代，平台团队提供让这一切可扩展的 Kubernetes 基础设施（GPU 节点、持久存储、批调度）。模型注册表则充当交接点，存储来自成功实验的元数据，供生产部署取用。

    The following list outlines the core features that define a model registry, providing essential capabilities for both public and local use cases:

    下面列出定义模型注册表的核心特性，它们为公共与本地两类用例提供关键能力：

  • Metadata management. Store information about model accuracy, dataset lineage, performance benchmarks, and other critical metadata.元数据管理。存储模型准确率、数据集谱系、性能基准及其他关键元数据。
    • 原书第 85 页
  • Model discovery and search. Search and retrieve models based on metadata such as architecture, hyperparameters, training datasets, and performance metrics. Supports filtering with range queries (e.g., accuracy > 0.95).模型发现与搜索。基于架构、超参数、训练数据集、性能指标等元数据搜索与检索模型；支持范围查询过滤（如 accuracy > 0.95）。
  • Version control. Track multiple versions of both models and training datasets. Model versioning enables comparison of different model iterations and rollback if necessary, while dataset versioning ensures reproducibility by tracking which data version was used for training and evaluation.版本控制。同时追踪模型与训练数据集的多个版本。模型版本管理可比较不同模型迭代、必要时回滚；数据集版本管理则通过追踪训练与评估所用的数据版本来确保可复现性。
  • Lifecycle management. Manage model stages such as experimentation, staging, production, and retirement. This feature is especially critical as part of continuous development workflows.生命周期管理。管理实验、staging、生产、退役等模型阶段。这一特性在持续开发工作流中尤为关键。
  • Access control. Provide fine-grained permissions for model visibility and usage, ensuring secure collaboration across teams.访问控制。为模型可见性与使用提供细粒度权限，确保跨团队安全协作。
  • Auditing and compliance. Maintain a record of model usage, approvals, and changes to ensure regulatory compliance and reproducibility.审计与合规。保留模型使用、审批与变更记录，以确保监管合规与可复现性。
  • Data pipelines. Integrate into CI/CD workflows, automating tasks like model validation, artifact packaging, and production rollout.数据管道。集成进 CI/CD 工作流，自动化模型验证、制品打包、生产发布等任务。

    • To provide a clearer understanding of how these features are implemented in real-world tools, we will examine four prominent model registries: Hugging Face Model Hub, MLflow Model Registry, Kubeflow Model Registry, and OCI Registries.

    为更清楚地理解这些特性在真实工具中如何实现，我们将考察四个有代表性的模型注册表：Hugging Face Model Hub、MLflow Model Registry、Kubeflow Model Registry 与 OCI Registries。

    Hugging Face Model Hub

    The Hugging Face Model Hub is the canonical platform for discovering and sharing open source machine learning models, including LLMs. As of early 2026, it hosts over two million models in general and more than 310,000 LLMs specifically, all publicly available. Much like GitHub serves as the primary hub for open source software development, Hugging Face has established itself as the leading platform for open source ML models.

    Hugging Face Model Hub 是发现与分享开源机器学习模型（包括 LLM）的权威平台。截至 2026 年初，它托管着超过 200 万个模型，其中 LLM 超过 31 万个，全部公开可用。正如 GitHub 是开源软件开发的主要枢纽，Hugging Face 已成为开源 ML 模型的领先平台。

    Each model entry in the catalog is accompanied by a Model Card. A Model Card provides a standardized summary of a machine learning model’s key characteristics, including its intended use case, training datasets, performance benchmarks, and limitations. It often contains links to the datasets used for training, evaluation metrics, and licensing information. Users can also try out models interactively using the

    目录中的每个模型条目都附有一张 Model Card（模型卡）。Model Card 以标准化方式概述一个 ML 模型的关键特征，包括预期用例、训练数据集、性能基准与局限；它常包含训练所用数据集的链接、评估指标与许可信息。用户还可使用内置的推理组件交互式试用模型——

    原书第 86 页

    built-in inference widget, which enables quick testing of the model directly from the web interface without requiring local setup. Figure 2-5 shows an example Model Card.

    该组件让你无需本地配置，直接在网页界面上快速测试模型。图 2-5 展示了一个 Model Card 示例。

    In addition to the web interface, Hugging Face also offers a REST API for programmatic access to its repository. This allows developers to query models, retrieve metadata, and integrate models directly into automated workflows and pipelines. The API simplifies tasks such as discovering the latest version of a model or filtering models based on specific criteria.

    除网页界面外，Hugging Face 还提供 REST API 以便编程方式访问其仓库。开发者可借此查询模型、检索元数据，并把模型直接集成进自动化工作流与管道。该 API 简化了“发现某模型的最新版本”或“按特定条件过滤模型”等任务。

    While the Hugging Face Hub is perfect for public model sharing and manual discovery, it has limitations for production use. As a public registry, it is not suitable for organizations that need to keep proprietary models private. It may also become limiting in fully automated workflows where model versions need to be programmatically tracked and managed. For such scenarios, a dedicated internal model registry becomes essential to ensure version control, traceability, privacy, and tighter integration into production pipelines.

    Hugging Face Hub 非常适合公共模型分享与手动发现，但在生产使用上有局限。作为公共注册表，它不适合需要私有专有模型的组织。在需要以编程方式追踪与管理模型版本的全自动工作流中，它也可能显得力不从心。对于这类场景，专用的内部模型注册表就变得必不可少——它能确保版本控制、可追溯性、隐私性，并与生产管道更紧密集成。

    MLflow Model Registry

    MLflow is a Linux Foundation project that manages the machine learning lifecycle, including experiment tracking, model packaging, and model registry.

    MLflow 是 Linux 基金会旗下项目，管理机器学习生命周期，包括实验追踪、模型打包与模型注册表。

    原书第 87 页

    MLflow was created by Databricks in 2018 to address the challenges of managing machine learning experiments and model artifacts consistently across teams and environments. Since its release as an open source project, MLflow has become widely adopted in the data science community for its simplicity and integration capabilities.

    MLflow 由 Databricks 于 2018 年创建，旨在解决跨团队、跨环境一致地管理机器学习实验与模型制品的挑战。自作为开源项目发布以来，MLflow 凭借其简洁性与集成能力在数据科学社区被广泛采用。

    The central element of MLflow is the Tracking Server, which acts as the main hub for managing and storing all experiment metadata, metrics, and model artifacts. It provides an interface where data scientists can log results, compare runs, and organize their models and expose them in the model registry. A rich set of visualizations allows you to follow the change of performance data and different hyperparameters.

    MLflow 的核心元素是 Tracking Server，它充当管理与存储所有实验元数据、指标和模型制品的主枢纽。它提供一个接口，让数据科学家可以记录结果、对比运行、组织模型并把它们暴露到模型注册表中。丰富的可视化让你能追踪性能数据与不同超参数的变化。

    The models themselves are stored in the simplest case locally on the filesystem. For production setups, MLflow supports pushing model artifacts to external storage systems like AWS S3 or downloading directly from the Hugging Face Hub. MLflow manages references to these storage locations through artifact URIs stored in the registry’s metadata.

    最简单情况下，模型本身就存储在本地文件系统上。对于生产部署，MLflow 支持把模型制品推送到 AWS S3 等外部存储系统，或直接从 Hugging Face Hub 下载。MLflow 通过存储在注册表元数据中的制品 URI 来管理对这些存储位置的引用。

    The MLflow Model Registry is a part of this Tracking Server, providing a centralized repository for versioning, tracking, and managing machine learning models. It allows data scientists to register models with rich metadata, including version history and performance metrics. Figure 2-6 shows the web UI of the MLflow Model Registry.

    MLflow Model Registry 是 Tracking Server 的一部分，提供一个集中仓库来版本化、追踪与管理机器学习模型。它允许数据科学家以丰富元数据注册模型，包括版本历史与性能指标。图 2-6 展示了 MLflow Model Registry 的 Web UI。

    While MLflow was not initially built with Kubernetes in mind, the platform can be deployed effectively on Kubernetes. The standard approach is deploying it as a web service using tools like Helm charts, where a PostgreSQL database often serves as the backend for storing metadata. MLflow does not introduce native Kubernetes CRDs, which means its integration with Kubernetes requires additional automation for tasks such as scaling and dynamic model serving.

    虽然 MLflow 最初并非为 Kubernetes 而生，但该平台完全可以在 Kubernetes 上有效部署。标准做法是用 Helm chart 等工具把它作为 Web 服务部署，通常用 PostgreSQL 数据库作为存储元数据的后端。MLflow 不引入原生 Kubernetes CRD，这意味着它与 Kubernetes 的集成还需要额外自动化来处理扩缩容、动态模型服务等任务。

    MLflow, while feature rich, was originally designed for traditional ML workflows. Its metadata management and artifact handling are well suited for traditional ML use cases, but LLMs often require specialized handling due to their size and complexity. MLflow has significantly improved its LLM support starting with the 3.0 release, introducing memory-efficient logging through the Transformers flavor that avoids loading large models into memory during artifact storage. Recent enhancements include a Prompt Registry for versioning prompts, an AI gateway for unified LLM provider access, native GenAI evaluation capabilities, enhanced tracing for LLM applications, and reference-based logging that stores Hugging Face Hub references instead of full model weights, substantially reducing storage requirements during development.

    MLflow 功能丰富，但最初是为传统 ML 工作流设计的。它的元数据管理与制品处理很适合传统 ML 用例，但 LLM 因其体量与复杂性常需要专门处理。MLflow 从 3.0 版本开始大幅改进了对 LLM 的支持：通过 Transformers flavor 引入内存高效的记录方式，避免在制品存储时把大模型加载进内存。近期增强包括：用于版本化 prompt 的 Prompt Registry、统一访问各 LLM 提供商的 AI gateway、原生 GenAI 评估能力、面向 LLM 应用的增强 tracing，以及基于引用的记录方式——存储 Hugging Face Hub 引用而非完整模型权重，从而在开发阶段大幅降低存储需求。

    For production deployments, however, full model weights typically still need to be downloaded and stored locally to ensure availability and performance. That said, these approaches can create challenges in production environments, such as the risk of losing access to external repositories or insufficient caching mechanisms for repeated large model retrievals. As a result, MLflow’s artifact storage and model handling techniques, though improving, may still require complementary infrastructure for LLM management at scale. For example, downloading large models repeatedly from a registry can become inefficient, and MLflow’s current artifact storage approach is not optimized for such high-volume data handling.

    但在生产部署中，为确保可用性与性能，完整模型权重通常仍需下载并存储在本地。即便如此，这些做法在生产环境中也会带来挑战，例如失去对外部仓库访问权限的风险，或反复拉取大模型时缓存机制不足。因此，MLflow 的制品存储与模型处理技术虽在改进，大规模管理 LLM 时可能仍需要补充基础设施。例如，反复从注册表下载大模型会变得低效，而 MLflow 当前的制品存储方式并未针对这种高体量数据处理做优化。

    原书第 91 页

    In summary, MLflow is primarily focused on the data science side of the ML lifecycle, providing a rich feature set for tracking data science experiments. Its biggest advantage is that it is very accessible and can be easily installed on local machines. While MLflow can be deployed on Kubernetes, its integration remains limited. For more Kubernetes-native solutions, alternatives like Kubeflow extend the concept of a model registry with deeper Kubernetes integration and additional observability features.

    总之，MLflow 主要聚焦 ML 生命周期中的数据科学一侧，为追踪数据科学实验提供了丰富特性集。它最大的优势是极易上手，可轻松安装在本机上。虽然 MLflow 可以部署在 Kubernetes 上，但集成度仍有限。要找更 Kubernetes 原生的方案，Kubeflow 等替代方案扩展了模型注册表的概念，提供更深的 Kubernetes 集成与额外的可观测性特性。

    Kubeflow Model Registry

    Kubeflow is a Kubernetes-native platform designed to simplify the entire machine learning lifecycle, including model training, serving, and model registry management. Initially developed by Google, Kubeflow is now an open source project under CNCF and consists of these loosely connected components:

    Kubeflow 是一个 Kubernetes 原生平台，旨在简化整个机器学习生命周期，包括模型训练、服务与模型注册表管理。Kubeflow 最初由 Google 开发，如今是 CNCF 旗下的开源项目，由以下这些松耦合的组件组成：

  • Kubeflow Dashboard. A central dashboard and hub that connect the authenticated web interfaces of Kubeflow and other ecosystem components.Kubeflow Dashboard。一个中央仪表板与枢纽，连接 Kubeflow 及生态中其他组件的已认证 Web 界面。
  • Kubeflow Notebooks. Component for running web-based development environments like Jupyter Notebooks inside your Kubernetes cluster by running them inside pods. No local installation is needed.Kubeflow Notebooks。用于在 Kubernetes 集群内、以 pod 方式运行 Jupyter Notebook 等基于 Web 的开发环境的组件，无需本地安装。
  • Kubeflow Pipelines. Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) is a platform for building and deploying portable and scalable machine learning workflows using Kubernetes.Kubeflow Pipelines。Kubeflow Pipelines（KFP）是一个基于 Kubernetes 构建与部署可移植、可扩展机器学习工作流的平台。
  • Kubeflow Trainer. Kubeflow Trainer is a unified interface for model training and fine-tuning on Kubernetes.     Figure 2-7 gives an overview of how the Model Registry interacts with the other parts of Kubeflow.

    图 2-7 概览了 Model Registry 如何与 Kubeflow 的其他部分交互。

    At its core, Kubeflow takes advantage of Kubernetes principles, with all tasks, including model registration and training, defined as containerized workloads. Unlike MLflow, which is a more flexible experiment tracking and model management tool, Kubeflow offers deeper Kubernetes integration through CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs), manifests, and native controllers for each ML lifecycle component.

    Kubeflow 的核心是利用 Kubernetes 原则——所有任务（包括模型注册与训练）都被定义为容器化负载。MLflow 是更灵活的实验追踪与模型管理工具，而 Kubeflow 通过 CustomResourceDefinition（CRD）、manifest 以及面向每个 ML 生命周期组件的原生控制器，提供更深的 Kubernetes 集成。

    The Kubeflow Model Registry serves as a central repository for managing machine learning models, their versions, and related metadata. It substantially simplifies the transition from experimentation to production deployments.

    Kubeflow Model Registry 充当一个中央仓库，用于管理机器学习模型、其版本及相关元数据。它大幅简化了从实验到生产部署的过渡。

    At its core, the registry uses a flexible entity-relationship model for metadata storage in a backend relational database (MySQL). This model, inspired by Google’s ML Metadata project, provides a structured, scalable approach to storing model lineage, metrics, and parameters. The Kubeflow Model Registry can standardize metadata, enable version control, and offer interoperability across Kubeflow components. This allows for robust tracking of model versions and the reuse of metadata for deployment or pipeline triggers.

    在核心上，该注册表使用一种灵活的实体-关系模型，把元数据存储在后端关系数据库（MySQL）中。这一模型受 Google ML Metadata 项目启发，为存储模型谱系、指标与参数提供了结构化、可扩展的方式。Kubeflow Model Registry 可标准化元数据、启用版本控制，并在 Kubeflow 各组件间提供互操作性，从而稳健地追踪模型版本，并把元数据复用于部署或管道触发。

    The registry relies on external dependencies such as MySQL for metadata storage, with a persistent volume required for durability. This needs to be taken into account when operating the registry in production setups. It exposes REST APIs and a Python SDK for interaction.

    该注册表依赖 MySQL 等外部组件存储元数据，并需要一个持久卷来保证持久性。在生产环境运维注册表时必须把这一点考虑进去。它对外暴露 REST API 与 Python SDK 供交互。

    原书第 93 页

    To use the registry you need to register a model first, along with its metadata. Example 2-5 shows how you can do this from within a Python program or a Jupyter Notebook.

    要使用注册表，你需要先把模型连同其元数据一起注册进去。例 2-5 展示如何在 Python 程序或 Jupyter Notebook 中完成这一操作。

    Example 2-5. Register a model at the Kubeflow Model Registry

    from model_registry import ModelRegistry

registry = ModelRegistry(
    server_address="http://model-registry-service.kubeflow.svc.cluster.local",
    port=8080,
    author="your name",
    is_secure=False
)
rm = registry.register_model(
    "iris",
    "gs://kfserving-examples/models/sklearn/1.0/model",
    model_format_name="sklearn",
    model_format_version="1",
    version="v1",
    description="Iris scikit-learn model",
    metadata={
        "accuracy": 3.14,
        "license": "BSD 3-Clause License",
    }
)
    • Create a proxy to the Model Registry running in the cluster. This code must run within a pod in the cluster to access the cluster-internal service address (.svc.cluster.local).为集群中运行的 Model Registry 创建代理。这段代码必须在集群内的 pod 中运行，才能访问集群内部服务地址（.svc.cluster.local）。
    • Register a model with metadata and reference to the location of the model data (in this case, Google Cloud Storage).注册一个模型，附带元数据，并引用模型数据所在位置（本例为 Google Cloud Storage）。

    When a model is registered at the registry, you can easily access this via a Python library call. You can also access the model via a REST API call directly to the service, as shown in Example 2-6.

    模型在注册表中注册后，你可以通过一次 Python 库调用轻松访问它；也可以像例 2-6 那样，直接对服务发 REST API 调用来访问。

    Example 2-6. Query the cluster-internal Model Registry with curl from a pod

    kubectl run -it --rm curl --image=curl --restart=Never \
   http://model-registry-service.kubeflow.svc.cluster.local/...
    • Run a curl command inside a temporary pod to query the cluster-internal Model Registry service.在临时 pod 内运行 curl 命令，查询集群内部的 Model Registry 服务。

    You can also access the Kubeflow Model Registry with a KServe InferenceService in order to initialize the InferenceService with the model data that the registry points to. See Example 2-7 for an example of how to do this.

    你还可以通过 KServe InferenceService 访问 Kubeflow Model Registry，用注册表所指向的模型数据来初始化 InferenceService。具体做法见例 2-7。

    Example 2-7. InferenceService accessing model data from the Kubeflow registry

    apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1

spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      storageUri: "model-registry://iris/v1"
      modelFormat:
        name: "sklearn"
        version: "1"

The actual storage URI is retrieved from the Model Registry metadata, providing an extra layer of indirection that allows changing storage locations without updating the InferenceService.对模型 ID 与版本的引用。真实存储 URI 从 Model Registry 元数据中取回，多了一层间接——可以在不更新 InferenceService 的情况下更换存储位置。

    OCI Registry

    An OCI (Open Container Initiative) Registry is a standard mechanism for storing and distributing container images, commonly used in Kubernetes environments. Familiar services like Docker Hub and Quay.io have made it easy for Kubernetes users to store and manage images without running a registry themselves. Some Kubernetes distributions, such as Red Hat OpenShift, even include a built-in OCI Registry.

    OCI（Open Container Initiative）Registry 是存储与分发容器镜像的标准机制，在 Kubernetes 环境中被广泛使用。Docker Hub、Quay.io 等大家熟悉的服务让 Kubernetes 用户无需自建注册表即可轻松存储与管理镜像；有些 Kubernetes 发行版（如 Red Hat OpenShift）甚至内置了 OCI Registry。

    What Is OCI?

    The Open Container Initiative (OCI) standardizes how containerized applications and artifacts are managed. Founded in 2015 by Docker and others under the Linux Foundation, OCI ensures interoperability and vendor neutrality in container technologies. It evolved from Docker’s proprietary format to avoid lock-in, becoming an open, extensible ecosystem.

    Open Container Initiative（OCI）对容器化应用与制品的管理方式做了标准化。OCI 由 Docker 等公司于 2015 年在 Linux 基金会旗下发起，确保容器技术的互操作性与厂商中立。它从 Docker 的专有格式演化而来，目的是避免锁定，最终成为一个开放、可扩展的生态。

    While OCI began with container images, it now supports diverse artifacts like Helm charts and generative AI models through its OCI artifacts specification. This makes registries highly versatile for modern workloads. See “Modelcars” on page 68 for how to use OCI images with model data via modelcars and “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74 for native OCI image volume mounts in Kubernetes.

    OCI 最初只管容器镜像，如今通过 OCI artifacts 规范支持 Helm chart、生成式 AI 模型等多种制品，使注册表对现代负载极为通用。如何通过 modelcars 把 OCI 镜像与模型数据配合使用，见第 68 页“Modelcars”；Kubernetes 中原生 OCI 镜像卷挂载，见第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”。

    An OCI Registry can store more than just container images. With the introduction of OCI 1.1, the specification expanded to support OCI artifacts, a generalization of the

    OCI Registry 能存储的不止容器镜像。随着 OCI 1.1 的推出，规范扩展为支持 OCI artifacts——它是对

    原书第 95 页

    original image format. OCI artifacts let you store arbitrary data types, making an OCI Registry suitable for hosting machine learning models, including LLMs. This means the registry can manage the entire model file rather than merely referencing external storage.

    原始镜像格式的泛化。OCI artifacts 让你能存储任意数据类型，使 OCI Registry 适合托管机器学习模型（包括 LLM）。这意味着注册表可以管理整个模型文件，而不仅仅是引用外部存储。

    OCI Registries provide versioning, immutability, persistence, and efficient distribution mechanisms that fit well with LLM hosting. Compared to MLflow and Kubeflow Registries, which primarily store model metadata and references to external storage, an OCI Registry focuses on storing the full model data itself.

    OCI Registry 提供版本化、不可变、持久化与高效分发机制，很适合托管 LLM。与主要存储模型元数据及外部存储引用的 MLflow、Kubeflow Registry 相比，OCI Registry 聚焦于存储完整模型数据本身。

    LLM model images are examples of “passive data images.” You don’t execute them; instead, you use them as immutable packages of model weights and configurations for inference runtimes. You can easily create such a data image by cloning a Hugging Face repository, as shown in Example 2-8.

    LLM 模型镜像是“被动数据镜像”的例子。你并不执行它们，而是把它们当作模型权重与配置的不可变包，供推理运行时使用。如例 2-8 所示，你可以通过克隆 Hugging Face 仓库轻松创建这样一个数据镜像。

    Example 2-8. Dockerfile for creating a container image that holds a model

    FROM alpine/git
RUN git lfs install \
 && git clone --depth 1 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct /models
ENTRYPOINT sh

    This Dockerfile can be used directly with podman or docker, as shown in Example 2-9, to create a self-contained OCI image file that has all the files needed to run the model. For simplicity, this example adds the entire model as a single layer. In production, consider adding each model chunk as its own layer so that container runtimes can download and cache them independently.

    这个 Dockerfile 可直接配合 podman 或 docker 使用，如例 2-9 所示，创建一个自包含的 OCI 镜像文件，内含运行模型所需的全部文件。为简单起见，本例把整个模型作为单一层加入。在生产中，建议把每个模型分片作为独立层，以便容器运行时独立下载与缓存。

    By leveraging OCI Registries, you can store, version, and distribute LLM models efficiently within Kubernetes-native infrastructure, integrating smoothly into MLOps pipelines and declarative workflows. See “Modelcars” on page 68 for using OCI images with modelcars and “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74 for native OCI image volume mounts.     利用 OCI Registry，你可以在 Kubernetes 原生基础设施内高效地存储、版本化与分发 LLM 模型，并顺畅接入 MLOps 管道与声明式工作流。如何把 OCI 镜像与 modelcars 配合使用，见第 68 页“Modelcars”；原生 OCI 镜像卷挂载，见第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”。这两种方式都允许 KServe InferenceService 直接从 OCI 镜像加载模型数据。

    Accessing Model Data in Kubernetes
    在 Kubernetes 中访问模型数据

    Now that we have seen the various model formats and solutions for how to register them for tracking and ease of discovery, let’s go into the details and learn how we can access the model data from within a Kubernetes cluster.

    既然已经看过各种模型格式、以及如何注册它们以便追踪与发现，现在我们深入细节，看看如何从 Kubernetes 集群内部访问模型数据。

    Chapter 1 described several ways GenAI models can be served on Kubernetes. They all require that the models be downloaded in some way. For all runtimes described in Chapter 1, similar methods exist for getting hold of the model data, but for demonstration purposes let’s stick to KServe as the prototypical example.

    第 1 章介绍了在 Kubernetes 上服务 GenAI 模型的几种方式。它们都要求模型以某种方式被下载下来。第 1 章所述的所有运行时都有类似的获取模型数据的方法，但为演示方便，我们以 KServe 作为典型示例。

    In the simplest case, the storage location is specified in an InferenceService resource, as shown in Example 2-10, by leveraging a storageUri that points to the model’s data location.

    最简单的情况下，存储位置在 InferenceService 资源中指定，如例 2-10 所示——借助一个指向模型数据位置的 storageUri。

    Example 2-10. InferenceService picking up model data from an S3 storage

    apiVersion: "serving.kserve.io/v1beta1"
kind: "InferenceService"
metadata:
  name: "mnist"
spec:
  predictor:
    serviceAccountName: sa
    tensorflow:
      storageUri: "s3://kserve-examples/mnist"
    • Kubernetes ServiceAccount that is associated with a Secret that holds the authentication credentials.与一个 Secret 关联的 Kubernetes ServiceAccount，该 Secret 持有认证凭据。
    • The runtime to use, TensorFlow in this example.要使用的运行时，本例为 TensorFlow。
    • Reference to an S3 bucket that holds the model data files.指向存放模型数据文件的 S3 桶。
    原书第 97 页

    The schema of this URI defines which backend stores the model data and where. Each schema triggers a so-called storage initializer, a component that translates into a runtime’s pod init-container. You can create and deploy your own storage initializers with KServe’s ClusterStorageContainer resource. As shown in Example 2-11, in this resource you specify a reference to an image holding the custom storage initializer and a list of URL schemas that should trigger that storage initializer. URLs that match these schemas can then be used as storageUri specification in an InferenceService.

    这个 URI 的 schema 决定了模型数据由哪个后端存储、存在何处。每种 schema 会触发一个所谓的 storage initializer（存储初始化器）——它在运行时 pod 中表现为一个 init-container。你可以用 KServe 的 ClusterStorageContainer 资源创建并部署自己的 storage initializer。如例 2-11 所示，在这个资源里你指定一个持有自定义 storage initializer 的镜像引用，以及一组应触发该 initializer 的 URL schema。匹配这些 schema 的 URL 随后即可在 InferenceService 中作为 storageUri 使用。

    Example 2-11. ClusterStorageContainer adding model-registry:// schema support

    apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: ClusterStorageContainer
metadata:
  name: model-registry-storage
spec:
  container:
    name: storage-initializer
    image: kubeflow/model-registry-storage-initializer
  supportedUriFormats:
    - prefix: model-registry://
    • Reference to the OCI image for executing the initializer logic.指向用于执行 initializer 逻辑的 OCI 镜像。
    • Register the URL schema model-registry so that it can be used in an InferenceService.注册 URL schema model-registry，使其可在 InferenceService 中使用。

    Kubernetes runs the storage initializer as an init-container before the model runtimes start; its only purpose is to make the model data available for the serving runtime.

    Kubernetes 在模型运行时启动之前，把 storage initializer 作为 init-container 运行；它唯一的目的就是让模型数据可供服务运行时使用。

    Init Containers and Sidecars

    Init containers and sidecars are powerful Kubernetes patterns for enhancing pod behavior. Init containers run first and perform one-time setup tasks, such as populating a shared volume with data needed by the main container. Sidecars, on the other hand, run alongside the main container, often providing auxiliary functionality like logging, data processing, or cross-container data sharing. Together, these patterns enable a flexible and modular design for pods. For more insights, check out the init container and sidecar patterns described in Kubernetes Patterns.

    Init container 与 sidecar 是 Kubernetes 中增强 pod 行为的强大模式。Init container 先运行，执行一次性的设置任务，例如把主容器所需的数据填充到共享卷中。Sidecar 则与主容器并行运行，常提供日志、数据处理、跨容器数据共享等辅助功能。这两种模式合在一起，让 pod 设计灵活而模块化。更多见解参见《Kubernetes Patterns》中描述的 init container 与 sidecar 模式。

    Table 2-2 shows the storage initializers that KServe supports out of the box.

    表 2-2 列出了 KServe 开箱即支持的 storage initializer。

    httpsDownload model data with HTTP
    用 HTTP 下载模型数据    		https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B
