    A common pattern in Kubernetes is sharing data among containers using dedicated node-local volumes. Most of the storage initializers from Table 2-2 download the model data into a node-local directory that is then shared and mounted by an LLM runtime so that it can access the data directly. For this purpose, Kubernetes provides the emptyDir volume type, which Kubernetes initializes as an empty directory, allowing all containers within the same pod to mount it. This includes init containers (which run first) and application containers (which run after the init containers). The model serving runtime then mounts this volume to access the prepared data. For more details and variations of this technique, refer to the immutable configuration pattern in Kubernetes Patterns.

    Kubernetes 中一个常见模式是用专用的节点本地卷在容器间共享数据。表 2-2 中的大多数 storage initializer 都把模型数据下载到一个节点本地目录，然后由 LLM 运行时共享挂载该目录，从而直接访问数据。为此 Kubernetes 提供了 emptyDir 卷类型——Kubernetes 把它初始化为一个空目录，允许同一 pod 内的所有容器挂载它，包括先运行的 init container 和之后运行的应用容器。模型服务运行时再挂载该卷来访问准备好的数据。关于这一技术的更多细节与变体，参见《Kubernetes Patterns》中的不可变配置模式。

    While emptyDir volumes provide node-local storage, they require copying model data for each pod instance. For scenarios where multiple replicas serve the same model, a more storage-efficient approach uses PersistentVolumes backed by shared distributed filesystems.

    虽然 emptyDir 卷提供节点本地存储，但它需要为每个 pod 实例复制模型数据。对于多个副本服务同一模型的场景，一种更省存储的做法是使用由共享分布式文件系统支撑的 PersistentVolume。

    Shared Storage with PersistentVolumes
    用 PersistentVolume 做共享存储

    When you run multiple replicas of an InferenceService, each replica needs access to the same model data. The approaches we’ve seen so far either download fresh copies from remote storage or package models in OCI images (see “OCI Image for Storing

    当你运行一个 InferenceService 的多个副本时，每个副本都需要访问同一份模型数据。目前我们看到的做法，要么从远程存储下载新副本，要么把模型打包进 OCI 镜像（见“用于存储

    原书第 99 页

    Model Data” on page 65). PersistentVolumes (PVs) offer a third approach: a single shared copy of model data accessible to many pods simultaneously.

    模型数据的 OCI 镜像”，第 65 页）。PersistentVolume（PV）提供了第三种方式：一份共享的模型数据副本，可同时被多个 pod 访问。

    PVs provide efficient model sharing through distributed filesystems like NFS or Ceph. Instead of maintaining per-node or per-pod copies, you store the model once and mount it across all replicas. This approach offers three key advantages: storage cost savings when running tens of replicas, separation of concerns where data scientists manage models externally while Kubernetes consumes them, and simplified model updates through a central storage location.

    PV 通过 NFS、Ceph 等分布式文件系统实现高效的模型共享。你不必为每个节点或每个 pod 维护副本，而是把模型存一次，再挂载到所有副本上。这种方式有三大优势：跑几十个副本时节省存储成本；关注点分离——数据科学家在外部管理模型，Kubernetes 消费模型；以及通过中央存储位置简化模型更新。

    Example 2-12 shows a basic PV and PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) configuration for model storage. The PV specifies ReadOnlyMany access mode, allowing multiple pods to mount the volume read-only simultaneously. The persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy determines what happens when the PVC is deleted: Retain preserves the data (preventing accidental model deletion), while Delete removes both the PV and underlying storage.

    例 2-12 展示了用于模型存储的一个基础 PV 与 PersistentVolumeClaim（PVC）配置。PV 指定 ReadOnlyMany 访问模式，允许多个 pod 同时只读挂载该卷。persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy 决定 PVC 被删除时会发生什么：Retain 保留数据（防止误删模型），而 Delete 会同时删除 PV 与底层存储。

    Example 2-12. PersistentVolume and PersistentVolumeClaim for model storage

    apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: llama-3-8b-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 20Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadOnlyMany
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  nfs:
    server: nfs-server.example.com
    path: /exports/models/llama-3-8b
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: llama-3-8b-pvc
  namespace: default
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadOnlyMany
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
    • Total storage capacity of the PV.PV 的总存储容量。
    • Allow multiple pods to mount read-only simultaneously.允许多个 pod 同时只读挂载。
    原书第 100 页
    • Retain data when the PVC is deleted (prevents accidental model deletion).PVC 删除时保留数据（防止误删模型）。
    • NFS is used here as an example; other distributed filesystems supported by your cluster (such as Ceph, AWS EFS, Azure Files, or Google Cloud Filestore) can be configured similarly.这里以 NFS 为例；你的集群支持的其他分布式文件系统（如 Ceph、AWS EFS、Azure Files、Google Cloud Filestore）也可类似配置。
    • The PVC must request compatible access mode with the PV.PVC 请求的访问模式必须与 PV 兼容。

    Model serving workloads typically need read-only access to model weights and configuration files. Inference engines read the model parameters but don’t modify them during serving. This read-only characteristic makes the ReadOnlyMany access mode ideal for model storage PVs.

    模型服务负载通常只需对模型权重与配置文件的只读访问。推理引擎在服务期间读取模型参数但不修改它们。这种只读特性使 ReadOnlyMany 访问模式成为模型存储 PV 的理想选择。

    Configuring read-only access happens at two levels. At the PV level, the ReadOnlyMany access mode permits multiple pods to mount the volume simultaneously for reading. At the pod level, setting readOnly: true in the volume mount specification reinforces this constraint and provides additional benefits.

    只读访问在两个层面配置。在 PV 层面，ReadOnlyMany 访问模式允许多个 pod 同时只读挂载该卷；在 pod 层面，在卷挂载规范中设置 readOnly: true 可强化这一约束，并带来额外好处。

    Read-only mounts deliver two performance advantages. First, the operating system can apply aggressive filesystem caching since it knows the data won’t change. Second, there’s no lock contention between replicas attempting concurrent access, eliminating coordination overhead that would occur with read-write mounts.

    只读挂载带来两方面性能优势。第一，操作系统知道数据不会改变，因而可以激进地使用文件系统缓存。第二，并发访问的副本之间不存在锁竞争，消除了读写挂载下会出现的协调开销。

    KServe (see “KServe” on page 20) supports PVs through the pvc:// storage URI scheme, enabling direct integration with PersistentVolumeClaims. Example 2-13 shows how to use the PV and PVC from Example 2-12 with an InferenceService.

    KServe（见第 20 页“KServe”）通过 pvc:// 存储 URI scheme 支持 PV，可直接与 PersistentVolumeClaim 集成。例 2-13 展示如何把例 2-12 中的 PV 与 PVC 用在一个 InferenceService 中。

    Example 2-13. InferenceService using PersistentVolumeClaim for model data

    apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: llama-pvc
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: pytorch
      storageUri: pvc://llama-3-8b-pvc/
    • Reference the PVC by name. KServe mounts the PVC directly into the model container at /mnt/models.按名字引用 PVC。KServe 把 PVC 直接挂载到模型容器的 /mnt/models 路径。

    Unlike storage initializers that download from remote sources like s3:// or gs://, the pvc:// scheme works differently. KServe creates a PVC-backed volume (named kserve-pvc-source) and mounts the PVC directly into the model container at /mnt/models.

    与从 s3://、gs:// 等远程源下载的 storage initializer 不同，pvc:// scheme 的工作方式不一样。KServe 创建一个由 PVC 支撑的卷（名为 kserve-pvc-source），并把 PVC 直接挂载到模型容器的 /mnt/models。

    原书第 101 页

    There’s no copying step: the runtime reads model files directly from the mounted PVC. The storage initializer still runs but performs essentially a no-op for PVC URIs since the volume mount handles the data access.

    这里没有复制步骤：运行时直接从挂载的 PVC 读取模型文件。storage initializer 仍会运行，但对 PVC URI 而言基本是空操作，因为数据访问已由卷挂载处理。

    This direct mount approach distinguishes PVs from other storage methods. While S3 or Google Cloud Storage initializers download and copy data to an emptyDir volume, PVs eliminate the copy step entirely. The model container accesses files through the network filesystem as if they are local, though network latency affects read performance.

    这种直接挂载方式把 PV 与其他存储方法区分开来。S3 或 Google Cloud Storage initializer 会把数据下载并复制到 emptyDir 卷，而 PV 完全省去了复制步骤。模型容器通过网络文件系统访问文件，就像它们是本地文件一样——不过网络延迟会影响读取性能。

    Access performance differs significantly between node-local and network-backed storage. Local access approaches—init-container copying, modelcars (see “Modelcars” on page 68), and OCI volumes (see “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74)—deliver the fastest inference performance through direct node-local I/O. Network access through PVs introduces latency on every read operation, with performance depending on network bandwidth and storage backend capabilities. The fundamental trade-off balances storage efficiency against access speed.

    节点本地存储与网络后端存储的访问性能差异显著。本地访问方式——init-container 复制、modelcars（见第 68 页“Modelcars”）、OCI 卷（见第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”）——通过直接的节点本地 I/O 提供最快的推理性能。通过 PV 的网络访问则在每次读操作上都引入延迟，性能取决于网络带宽与存储后端能力。根本权衡在于存储效率与访问速度之间。

    Parallel access scalability depends on multiple factors: backend storage performance, model size, inference throughput requirements, and available network bandwidth. PVs work well for typical GPU-based inference deployments (10–20 replicas), where GPU costs naturally limit scale. CPU-based inference might scale higher, and storage backend performance becomes the limiting factor. Warning signs include disk pressure on the storage backend, increased I/O wait times, and inconsistent response latencies. Potential bottlenecks arise from network saturation, NFS server load limits, and concurrent read contention.

    并行访问的可扩展性取决于多个因素：后端存储性能、模型大小、推理吞吐需求、可用网络带宽。PV 很适合典型的基于 GPU 的推理部署（10–20 个副本）——GPU 成本天然限制了规模。基于 CPU 的推理可能扩得更大，那时存储后端性能会成为限制因素。警示信号包括：存储后端磁盘压力、I/O 等待时间上升、响应延迟不稳定。潜在瓶颈来自网络饱和、NFS 服务器负载上限、并发读竞争。

    The Kubernetes ecosystem recognizes “too many pods sharing one PVC” as a real problem class, though no canonical threshold exists. High-performance storage systems like Ceph or cloud-based services (AWS EFS, Azure Files) handle more concurrent load than basic NFS setups. For high-scale deployments or high-throughput inference requirements, consider node-local approaches like OCI volumes that we’ll discuss in “OCI Image for Storing Model Data” on page 65.

    Kubernetes 生态把“太多 pod 共享一个 PVC”视为一类真实问题，尽管没有公认的阈值。Ceph 或 AWS EFS、Azure Files 等云端高性能存储系统能比基础 NFS 部署处理更多并发负载。对于大规模部署或高吞吐推理需求，请考虑节点本地方式，如我们将在第 65 页“用于存储模型数据的 OCI 镜像”中讨论的 OCI 卷。

    PVs offer fast startup since mounting requires no data copying, just establishing the network mount. In scale-to-zero scenarios, every pod restart requires remounting over the network, and there’s no benefit from local caching across pod restarts.

    PV 启动快，因为挂载不需要复制数据，只需建立网络挂载。但在缩容到零的场景中，每次 pod 重启都要重新走网络挂载，且 pod 重启之间无法受益于本地缓存。

    In “Lessons Learned” on page 76, we’ll compare PVs against other model data access methods to help you choose the right approach for your requirements.

    在第 76 页“本章小结”中，我们会把 PV 与其他模型数据访问方式做对比，帮你按需求选择合适方案。

    Beyond PersistentVolumes, OCI images offer another approach for transferring and storing model data. The following sections explore how to package models as OCI images and access them efficiently from LLM runtimes.

    除 PersistentVolume 之外，OCI 镜像为传输与存储模型数据提供了另一种方式。下面几节探讨如何把模型打包成 OCI 镜像，并从 LLM 运行时高效访问。

    原书第 102 页

    OCI Image for Storing Model Data
    用于存储模型数据的 OCI 镜像

    In 2013 Docker invented a clever layered format for storing container blueprints. The original and still prevalent usage for those images is to store beside the kernel all the binaries and files that make up a Linux operating system. It is a layered format so that users can create base images that can be reused for different specialized images, for example, those containing the applications that will be run in a container. Multiple containers share layers when running if they refer to the same layers.

    2013 年，Docker 发明了一种巧妙的分层格式来存储容器蓝图。这些镜像最初、也是至今最常见的用途，是在内核旁存储构成一个 Linux 操作系统的所有二进制与文件。它是分层格式，因此用户可以创建基础镜像，供不同的专用镜像复用——例如那些包含将在容器中运行的应用的镜像。多个容器在运行时若引用相同层，就会共享这些层。

    In addition to the read-only layers of an image, Docker uses a union filesystem that adds a read-write layer on top of the image layer stack, so that different container instances can still share the same underlying operating system files. One key benefit of this schema is that the read-only layers can be cached individually, which makes working with OCI images very efficient as only changed layers need to be distributed.

    除镜像的只读层之外，Docker 使用一个联合文件系统，在镜像层栈之上加一个可读写层，使不同容器实例仍能共享同一份底层操作系统文件。这一模式的一个关键好处是：只读层可以被单独缓存，从而让 OCI 镜像的处理非常高效——只有发生变化的层才需要分发。

    We don’t go into much detail about the concrete format here as many aspects are not relevant when we store model data in such layers. For the moment it is important that you can share layers and that an OCI image is built up hierarchically; i.e., the layers are stacked. This stacking matches nicely for model composition techniques like finetuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters on top of foundational models. We will see more about LoRA in “Low-Rank Adaptation” on page 187. These foundational models, stored in base images, can be shared when running on the cluster nodes, which makes it very efficient to run multiple specialized fine-tuned models.

    这里我们不深入具体格式，因为当我们把模型数据存进这些层时，很多方面并不相关。此刻重要的是：你可以共享层，而且 OCI 镜像是分层（即层层堆叠）构建起来的。这种堆叠与模型组合技术非常契合——例如在基础模型之上用 Low-Rank Adaptation（LoRA）适配器做微调。关于 LoRA 的更多内容见第 187 页“Low-Rank Adaptation”。这些存放在基础镜像中的基础模型，在集群节点上运行时可以被共享，从而非常高效地运行多个专用微调模型。

    Figure 2-8 shows how such images are composed. At the end, all layers are packed into a tar archive that is stored in an OCI Registry.

    图 2-8 展示了这类镜像如何组成。最终，所有层被打包进一个 tar 归档，存储在 OCI Registry 中。

    原书第 103 页

    Docker’s success eventually led to a standardization of the OCI image specification. A full ecosystem of supporting tools, from registries for hosting OCI images to CLI tooling, like skopeo or oras for inspecting and managing OCI images, has emerged over time. Putting LLMs into OCI images piggybacks on this existing landscape and automatically benefits from the existing work that has been done in this area.

    Docker 的成功最终推动了 OCI 镜像规范的标准化。随着时间推移，一个完整的工具生态已经形成：从托管 OCI 镜像的注册表，到 skopeo、oras 这类用于检视与管理 OCI 镜像的 CLI 工具。把 LLM 放进 OCI 镜像，正是搭在这套既有生态之上，自动受益于这一领域已有的工作。

    In “Deploying Models to Kubernetes Manually” on page 16, we’ve seen how to deploy an LLM model with a vanilla Kubernetes deployment resource. Example 1-9 showed the model data being downloaded on the fly from the Hugging Face Hub, but we could also initialize the model data directly from an OCI container image. Example 2-14 shows a similar deployment, but this time we are introducing an emptyDir volume for sharing the model data.

    在第 16 页“手动部署模型到 Kubernetes”中，我们看过如何用一个朴素的 Kubernetes deployment 资源部署 LLM 模型。例 1-9 展示了模型数据在运行时从 Hugging Face Hub 下载，但我们也可以直接从 OCI 容器镜像初始化模型数据。例 2-14 展示了一个类似的 deployment，但这一次我们引入了一个 emptyDir 卷来共享模型数据。

    Example 2-14. Deployment with init-container copying model data to emptyDir volume

    kind: Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
metadata:
  name: vllm
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: copy-model-data
        image: quay.io/rhuss/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct:latest
        command:
        - "sh"
        - "-c"
        - "cp -a /models/. /mnt/models"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: models
          mountPath: /mnt/models
      containers:
      - name: vllm
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
        args:
        - "--served-model-name",
        - "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct",
        - "--model",
          "/mnt/models"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: models
          mountPath: /mnt/models
      volumes:
        - name: models
          emptyDir: {}
    原书第 104 页
    • OCI image holding the model data for Qwen 2.5 in the directory /models (see Example 2-9).持有 Qwen 2.5 模型数据的 OCI 镜像，数据位于 /models 目录（见例 2-9）。
    • Copy over the data from the image directory /models to the mounted /mnt/models directory that is backed by an emptyDir volume. This might take some time depending on the size of the model to copy.把数据从镜像目录 /models 复制到由 emptyDir 卷支撑的挂载目录 /mnt/models。根据要复制的模型大小，这可能需要一些时间。
    • Mount the emptyDir volume to the /mnt/models in the init-container.在 init-container 中把 emptyDir 卷挂载到 /mnt/models。
    • Run vLLM so that it accesses the model stored in /mnt/models.运行 vLLM，让它访问存储在 /mnt/models 中的模型。
    • Mount the shared directory on /mnt/models in the application container to access the data copied by the init-container.在应用容器中把共享目录挂载到 /mnt/models，以访问 init-container 复制过来的数据。
    • Volume declaration for an empty node-local directory.声明一个空的节点本地目录作为卷。

    The technique demonstrated in Example 2-14 shows how model data is typically initialized for a deployed model, whether it’s downloaded from an S3 bucket or extracted from an OCI image. KServe’s storage initializers, as listed in Table 2-2, use this same init-container approach to copy model data from various sources. Besides downloading the data from some source, this technique involves an expensive copy step that is performed every time a runtime pod is started.

    例 2-14 演示的技术展示了已部署模型的模型数据通常如何初始化——无论它是从 S3 桶下载，还是从 OCI 镜像解包。表 2-2 列出的 KServe storage initializer 也采用同样的 init-container 方式，从各种来源复制模型数据。除了从某个来源下载数据之外，这种方式还包含一次昂贵的复制步骤——每次启动运行时 pod 都要做一遍。

    The following sections demonstrate how this copying over of gigabyte-sized amounts of data can be avoided by directly accessing the data that is contained in an OCI model data image.

    下面几节演示如何避免这种 GB 级数据的反复复制——直接访问 OCI 模型数据镜像中包含的数据。

    CNCF ModelPack Specification

    The CNCF ModelPack specification is a CNCF Sandbox project that extends the OCI image specification for packaging and distributing AI models. It targets an expansion of the OCI standard to support AI model artifacts, including model weights, metadata, and configurations. The goal is to standardize model storage and management, ensuring better compatibility across different runtime environments. By leveraging OCI’s extensible architecture, it aims to simplify model deployment and sharing.

    CNCF ModelPack 规范是一个 CNCF Sandbox 项目，它扩展了 OCI 镜像规范，用于打包与分发 AI 模型。它旨在扩展 OCI 标准以支持 AI 模型制品，包括模型权重、元数据与配置。目标是标准化模型存储与管理，确保跨运行时环境更好的兼容性。借助 OCI 可扩展的架构，它力求简化模型部署与共享。

    This initiative complements OCI’s image volume mount capabilities, described later in “Modelcars” on page 68 and “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74. The definition of new annotation types is also part of the specification. The specification was accepted into the CNCF Sandbox in May 2025, reflecting strong community interest and strong industry support. Its success will lead to a more unified approach to operationalizing AI workloads in cloud-native environments.

    这一举措是对 OCI 镜像卷挂载能力的补充——后者将在第 68 页“Modelcars”与第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”中介绍。规范还包括对新注解类型的定义。该规范于 2025 年 5 月被 CNCF Sandbox 接纳，反映出强烈的社区兴趣与业界支持。它的成功将为云原生环境中运维 AI 负载带来更统一的方式。

    原书第 105 页

    Modelcars

    As we have seen in Example 2-14, you can easily access models stored in OCI images. However, this way of copying all the model data into an intermediate storage has some drawbacks.

    如例 2-14 所示，你可以轻松访问存储在 OCI 镜像中的模型。但这种把全部模型数据复制到中间存储的做法有一些缺点。

    Direct access to model data stored in an OCI image without copying would significantly speed up initialization and reduce node space usage. An image needs to be downloaded only once but can be used simultaneously by many pods. Also, for an LLM model that can benefit from the layered nature of OCI images (like LoRA fine-tuned models), the overall storage space needed for specialized models that are based on the same foundational model is reduced. The image layers of the foundation model can be shared among the specialized models, reducing the required disk space considerably.

    若能不复制、直接访问 OCI 镜像中的模型数据，将大幅加快初始化、减少节点空间占用。镜像只需下载一次，却可被多个 pod 同时使用。此外，对于能受益于 OCI 镜像分层特性的 LLM 模型（如 LoRA 微调模型），基于同一基础模型的各专用模型所需的总体存储空间也会减少。基础模型的镜像层可在这些专用模型之间共享，从而显著降低所需磁盘空间。

    Kubernetes has long lacked support for this use case. Although the feature request was already recorded more than 10 years ago in GitHub issue 831, it was not considered for implementation for many years.

    Kubernetes 长期缺乏对这一用例的支持。虽然相关 feature request 在 10 多年前就记录在 GitHub issue 831 中，但多年来都未被考虑实现。

    However, things have changed with the advent of LLMs and the desire to ship model data in OCI images. Beginning with Kubernetes 1.35, you can use now image volume mounts directly in your pod specs. However, it might take some time until image volume mounts move out of the experimental stage and are considered stable.

    然而，随着 LLM 的出现与“把模型数据装进 OCI 镜像”的需求，情况已经改变。从 Kubernetes 1.35 开始，你可以直接在 pod 规范中使用镜像卷挂载。不过，镜像卷挂载从实验阶段走向稳定可能还需要一段时间。

    We talk in detail later about OCI image volume mounts, but KServe uses a technique to achieve the same behavior for older Kubernetes versions. You might consider jumping directly to “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74 if you can already leverage OCI volume mounts, since modelcars can be considered a temporary solution you can use today. OCI image volumes will support everything that modelcars provide, but it is a much cleaner and more standardized technique. You should use OCI image volumes whenever you can; rely on modelcars if this is not yet possible.

    我们后面会详细讨论 OCI 镜像卷挂载，但 KServe 用一种技术在较旧的 Kubernetes 版本上实现了同样的行为。如果你已经能用 OCI 卷挂载，可以直接跳到第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”——因为 modelcar 可视为你今天就能用的临时方案。OCI 镜像卷将支持 modelcar 提供的一切，而且是更干净、更标准化的技术。只要能用 OCI 镜像卷就尽量用；尚不能用时再依靠 modelcar。

    Example 2-15 shows how modelcars can be configured in KServe using a simpler scikit-learn model for illustration. Unlike the vanilla Kubernetes deployment in Example 2-14, KServe’s InferenceService resource handles the modelcar setup automatically. The oci:// URL format is KServe-specific syntax for referencing OCI images containing model data, and the model data stored in the referenced image will be directly accessed without prior copying into a volume. Modelcars can speed up the startup of a model runtime considerably, especially when working with a large data set.

    例 2-15 展示如何在 KServe 中配置 modelcar——为说明方便，这里用一个较简单的 scikit-learn 模型。与例 2-14 的朴素 Kubernetes deployment 不同，KServe 的 InferenceService 资源会自动处理 modelcar 的设置。oci:// URL 格式是 KServe 特有的语法，用于引用包含模型数据的 OCI 镜像；所引用镜像中存储的模型数据将被直接访问，而不必事先复制到卷中。Modelcar 可显著加快模型运行时的启动，尤其是在处理大数据集时。

    原书第 106 页

    Example 2-15. InferenceService that uses model data from an OCI image

    apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: "sklearn-iris-oci"
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: sklearn
      # OCI Registry and repository of the image holding the model data
      storageUri: "oci://rhuss/kserving-example-sklearn:1.0"

    The remaining part of this section is a deep dive

    The remaining part of this section is a deep dive into the technical architecture and implementation of modelcars. Because the level of detail is greater than most of the rest of the book, you may wish to skip directly to “OCI Image Volume Mounts” on page 74. However, we feel that the pattern behind this technique proves useful in other scenarios when you have to deal with a large amount of data, so we’ll keep it here for some technical fun and educational purposes.

    本节剩余部分是对 modelcar 技术架构与实现的深入剖析。由于细节程度高于本书其他大部分内容，你可以直接跳到第 74 页“OCI 镜像卷挂载”。不过我们认为，这种技术背后的模式在其他需要处理海量数据的场景中也很有用，所以把它保留在这里，供一些技术上的乐趣与教学目的。

    The Kubernetes’ pod specification supports a relatively unknown property called shareProcessNamespace. By default, containers that Kubernetes starts for a pod cannot see each other. Running ps aux inside a container shows only the processes started by that container. This is great for keeping containers isolated. Setting shareProcessNamespace to true allows the container to “see” other processes from other containers. You can also access the filesystem from all containers via the /proc filesystem.

    Kubernetes 的 pod 规范支持一个相对鲜为人知的属性 shareProcessNamespace。默认情况下，Kubernetes 为 pod 启动的容器彼此互相不可见；在一个容器里运行 ps aux 只能看到该容器自己启动的进程。这对保持容器隔离很好。把 shareProcessNamespace 设为 true，可让容器“看到”其他容器中的进程，你还可以通过 /proc 文件系统访问所有容器的文件系统。

    Example 2-16 shows how this cross-container filesystem access can be tested.

    例 2-16 展示如何测试这种跨容器文件系统访问。

    Example 2-16. Accessing another container’s root filesystem

    $ cat spns.yaml

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: spns
spec:
  containers:
  - image: docker.io/httpd
    name: httpd
  - image: docker.io/busybox
    name: busybox
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
  shareProcessNamespace: false

$ kubectl apply -f spns.yaml

# Jump into the busybox container
$ kubectl exec -it spns -c busybox -- sh

$$ ps

PID   USER     TIME  COMMAND
    1 root      0:00 sleep infinity
    7 root      0:00 sh
   14 root      0:00 ps aux

$$ ls -d /proc [0-9]*
/proc/1  /proc/7

# Root filesystem of PID 1
$$ ls /proc/1/root/
bin    dev    etc    home   lib    lib64
proc   root   run    sys    tmp    usr    var

# Jump out of the container again
$$ exit

# Change `shareProcessNamespace` from false to true
$ sed 's/false/true/' spns.yml | kubectl apply --force -f -

# Jump into busybox container like before
$ kubectl exec -it spns -c busybox -- sh
$$ ps

PID   USER     TIME  COMMAND
    1 root      0:00 /pause
    7 root      0:00 httpd -DFOREGROUND
   15 www-data  0:00 httpd -DFOREGROUND
   16 www-data  0:00 httpd -DFOREGROUND
   17 www-data  0:00 httpd -DFOREGROUND
   99 root      0:00 sleep infinity
  126 root      0:00 sh
  132 root      0:00 ps

# Show data from the other container
$$ head -3 /proc/7/root/usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf
#
# This is the main Apache HTTP server configuration file.  It contains the
# configuration directives that give the server its instructions.
    原书第 107 页
    • Simple pod with two containers: an Apache HTTP server and a busybox that sleeps forever to keep the container running. No process namespace sharing is enabled here.一个简单 pod，含两个容器：一个 Apache HTTP server，以及一个 busybox——后者永远睡眠以保持容器运行。此处未启用进程命名空间共享。
    • Only the processes from the container’s process namespace are visible. The specified command has PID 1 when process namespace isolation is enabled.只能看到本容器进程命名空间内的进程。在启用进程命名空间隔离时，所指定命令的 PID 为 1。
    • Root filesystem of process PID 1 (which is the same as ls /).PID 1 进程的根文件系统（等同于 ls /）。
    • When process namespace sharing is enabled, the PIDs from the other containers can be seen, too.启用进程命名空间共享后，也能看到其他容器中的 PID。
    原书第 108 页
    • Via the proc filesystem, a file specific to the httpd-container can be accessed from the busybox container.通过 proc 文件系统，可从 busybox 容器访问 httpd 容器特有的文件。

    Accessing other processes’ filesystems

    You can access other processes’ filesystems only when Unix permissions allow. Ideally, the processes from all containers use the same UID, so that cross-container filesystem access should not be an issue. However, depending on your cluster setup, additional mechanisms like SELinux might affect the ability to access another container’s filesystem, even when using that UID or using UID 0 for the containers.

    只有在 Unix 权限允许时，你才能访问其他进程的文件系统。理想情况下，所有容器中的进程使用同一 UID，这样跨容器文件系统访问应不成问题。不过根据集群配置，SELinux 等额外机制可能影响访问另一个容器文件系统的能力——即便使用该 UID 或让容器使用 UID 0。

    This technique to cross-share the containers’ filesystems is universal to Kubernetes and can be used for any deployed workload, regardless of whether you have deployed the runtime yourself or via an add-on platform.

    这种跨容器共享文件系统的技术对 Kubernetes 是通用的，可用于任何已部署负载——无论你是自己部署运行时，还是通过附加平台部署。

    Although it’s not necessary to understand what happens behind the scenes, it’s enlightening how KServe implements direct image mounting. The technique is independent of KServe and can also be used in other contexts where access to large datasets stored in OCI images is required.

    虽然不了解幕后原理也无所谓，但了解 KServe 如何实现直接镜像挂载是很有启发性的。这一技术独立于 KServe，也可用于其他需要访问 OCI 镜像中存储的大数据集的场景。

    Figure 2-9 shows the components and structure of a modelcar in KServe.

    图 2-9 展示了 KServe 中 modelcar 的组件与结构。

    原书第 109 页

    The serving runtime and the modelcar container are starting in parallel. During the startup, the modelcar creates a symbolic link from its filesystem to a shared emptyDir volume accessible by both containers. Then, the modelcar goes into an infinite sleep to keep the container alive.

    服务运行时与 modelcar 容器并行启动。在启动过程中，modelcar 从自己的文件系统创建一个符号链接，指向一个两个容器都可访问的共享 emptyDir 卷；随后 modelcar 进入无限睡眠，以保持容器存活。

    This linking operation is part of the modelcar’s startup command and requires minimal resources—less than 10 MB of memory to maintain idle status. It’s important to emphasize that no data is copied over; just a symbolic link is created to allow the serving runtime container to find the model data at a fixed location (e.g., /mnt/models).

    这个链接操作是 modelcar 启动命令的一部分，资源占用极小——维持空闲状态不到 10 MB 内存。需要强调的是：这里没有复制任何数据，只是创建了一个符号链接，让服务运行时容器能在固定位置（如 /mnt/models）找到模型数据。

    Example 2-17 shows the pod definition that results from the creation of an InferenceService. The important part here is the creation of the link and the mount of the shared emptyDir volume to hold the symbolic link to follow for cross-container access.

    例 2-17 展示了创建 InferenceService 后产生的 pod 定义。这里的关键是：创建链接，以及挂载共享 emptyDir 卷——该卷持有跨容器访问所要跟随的符号链接。

    Example 2-17. Pod with modelcar sidecar using /proc symlink for model data

    apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: sklearn-iris-oci-predictor-00001-deployment-7fd9c7fc67-dzdsz
  namespace: default
spec:
  shareProcessNamespace: true
  containers:
  - name: kserve-container
    image: kserve/sklearnserver
    args:
    - --model_name=sklearn-iris-oci
    - --model_dir=/mnt/models
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /mnt
      name: kserve-provision-location
  - name: modelcar
    image: rhuss/kserving-example-sklearn:1.0
    args:
    - sh
    - -c
    - ln -s /proc/$$$$/root/models /mnt/models && sleep infinity
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /mnt
      name: kserve-provision-location
  volumes:
  - name: kserve-provision-location
    emptyDir: {}
    • Serving runtime that executes on the model from the modelcar.在 modelcar 中的模型上执行推理的服务运行时。
    原书第 110 页
    • Mounting the shared local directory on /mnt so that the model can be accessed from /mnt/models.把共享本地目录挂载到 /mnt，以便从 /mnt/models 访问模型。
    • Modelcar image that holds the model data.持有模型数据的 modelcar 镜像。
    • Creates a symbolic link /mnt/models that points into the modelcar’s own root filesystem, accessible via the proc filesystem. In YAML, the $$$$ gets replaced with $$, which is the special shell variable that holds the modelcar’s shell process ID. After the link is created, the modelcar sleeps indefinitely to keep the container alive.创建符号链接 /mnt/models，指向 modelcar 自身的根文件系统（通过 proc 文件系统访问）。在 YAML 中，$$$$ 会被替换为 $$——这是一个特殊 shell 变量，持有 modelcar shell 进程的 PID。链接创建后，modelcar 无限睡眠以保持容器存活。
    • Declaration of the shared emptyDir volume that is referenced in the container declaration for the serving runtime and the modelcar.声明共享 emptyDir 卷；服务运行时与 modelcar 的容器声明中都引用了它。

    While the modelcar technique proved to be very valuable for optimizing the initialization of LLMs, it also has a handful of drawbacks:

    虽然 modelcar 技术在优化 LLM 初始化方面非常有价值，但它也有几个缺点：

  • Startup order. Serving runtimes typically assume the model data is already present when they start up. However, with modelcars, the modelcar container and runtime container start in parallel. This can lead to the runtime starting before the model is available. Despite modelcar containers starting quickly, startup is slower when the modelcar image still needs to be pulled from an OCI Registry. This can be mitigated by using the Kubernetes sidecar support, available since Kubernetes 1.28 as an optional feature, so that the runtime starts only when the modelcar is initialized. For setups where sidecars are not enabled, you still can minimize the risk of a race condition by pre-pulling the modelcar image in an init-container to ensure that when the modelcar sidecar starts, the modelcar OCI image is already present at the cluster node.启动顺序。服务运行时通常假设启动时模型数据已经就绪。但用 modelcar 时，modelcar 容器与运行时容器是并行启动的，这可能导致运行时在模型就绪之前就启动。尽管 modelcar 容器启动很快，但当 modelcar 镜像仍需从 OCI Registry 拉取时，启动就会变慢。这可以通过使用 Kubernetes sidecar 支持（自 Kubernetes 1.28 起作为可选特性）来缓解——这样运行时只在 modelcar 初始化完成后才启动。对于未启用 sidecar 的部署，你仍可在 init-container 中预先拉取 modelcar 镜像，以最大程度降低竞态风险——确保 modelcar sidecar 启动时，modelcar OCI 镜像已存在于集群节点上。
  • Security. Enabling shareProcessNamespace allows access to the process namespace and filesystems of all containers defined for a pod. This is especially important to remember when other sidecars are included. A prominent example is the service mesh Istio that uses sidecars to provide its functionality. Istio sidecars assume they are fully isolated, so they don’t implement any precautions to hide sensitive information like the access configuration to their upstream Istio daemon. As shown in this security report, the lack of additional encryption of the local Istio configuration can be easily exploited. Understanding the consequences when using tools and platforms like Istio or Knative that perform sidecar injections is therefore critical.安全性。启用 shareProcessNamespace 后，可以访问一个 pod 所定义的所有容器的进程命名空间与文件系统。当还有其他 sidecar 时，这一点尤其需要牢记。一个著名例子是服务网格 Istio——它用 sidecar 提供功能。Istio sidecar 假设自己完全隔离，因此没有采取任何措施来隐藏敏感信息，例如访问其上游 Istio 守护进程的配置。如那篇安全报告所示，本地 Istio 配置缺少额外加密很容易被利用。因此，在使用 Istio 或 Knative 这类会做 sidecar 注入的工具与平台时，理解其后果至关重要。
    • 原书第 111 页
  • Nonuniform startup times. Depending on whether the model OCI image has already been loaded in the Kubernetes’ node OCI runtime, the actual serving runtime can either start quickly or might take several minutes until a potentially large model OCI image is downloaded from a registry. To make the startup times more predictable, which is especially important in scale-to-zero scenarios, optimization techniques like image prefetching can be leveraged.启动时间不均匀。取决于模型 OCI 镜像是否已加载到 Kubernetes 节点的 OCI runtime 中，实际服务运行时可能启动很快，也可能要花几分钟从注册表下载一个可能很大的模型 OCI 镜像。为让启动时间更可预测——这在缩容到零的场景中尤其重要——可以利用镜像预取等优化技术。
  • Multiarchitecture support. Modelcars require an active process to keep the sidecar alive. This process is specific to a certain CPU architecture, so if you want to use modelcar images in a multiarchitecture setup, then you need to create copies of modelcars, one for each supported CPU architecture. Those images contain the same ML model, thus wasting resources. However, tools like BuildKit, umoci, or skopeo can mitigate this duplication by creating multiarchitecture images with manifest lists that share architecture-independent layers (like model data) across platforms, while duplicating only the architecture-specific executable layers. This approach leverages OCI’s content-addressable storage to deduplicate shared layers automatically when pushed to registries.多架构支持。Modelcar 需要一个活动进程来保持 sidecar 存活。该进程特定于某种 CPU 架构，因此若要在多架构部署中使用 modelcar 镜像，就需要为每种支持的 CPU 架构各创建一份 modelcar 副本。这些镜像包含同一个 ML 模型，因而浪费资源。不过 BuildKit、umoci、skopeo 等工具可以缓解这种重复：它们创建带 manifest list 的多架构镜像，跨平台共享架构无关的层（如模型数据），只复制架构相关的可执行层。这种方式利用 OCI 的内容寻址存储，在推送到注册表时自动对共享层去重。

    • All of these drawbacks can be overcome by real OCI image volume mounts. Luckily, Kubernetes 1.35 offers OCI image sources for volumes as a beta feature. It will still take some time until this mount type is generally available; in the meantime, modelcars are a good bridging technology with a smooth upgrade path until OCI image volume mounts arrive for everyone.

    所有这些缺点都可以通过真正的 OCI 镜像卷挂载来克服。幸运的是，Kubernetes 1.35 已把 OCI 镜像作为卷来源提供为 beta 特性。这种挂载类型走向 GA 仍需时日；在此期间，modelcar 是一种很好的过渡技术，提供了平滑的升级路径，直到 OCI 镜像卷挂载面向所有人可用。

    OCI Image Volume Mounts
    OCI 镜像卷挂载

    Starting with Kubernetes 1.31, pods can directly mount OCI container images as volumes without the need to copy model data first. This feature provides an efficient way to access large model artifacts stored in OCI images, reducing both initialization time and storage overhead.

    从 Kubernetes 1.31 开始，pod 可以直接把 OCI 容器镜像挂载为卷，而无需先复制模型数据。这一特性提供了一种高效方式来访问存储在 OCI 镜像中的大型模型制品，同时减少初始化时间与存储开销。

    The benefit of direct image mounts over the modelcar approach (see “Modelcars” on page 68) is that it avoids the need for symbolic links or process namespace sharing. Instead, model data can be directly read from the image layers as a mounted volume, benefiting from the underlying OCI image layer cache.

    相比 modelcar 方式（见第 68 页“Modelcars”），直接镜像挂载的好处是：它不需要符号链接或进程命名空间共享。取而代之，模型数据可作为挂载卷直接从镜像层读取，并受益于底层 OCI 镜像层缓存。

    Example 2-18 shows how to use an OCI image volume mount to serve a model directly with vLLM.

    例 2-18 展示如何使用 OCI 镜像卷挂载，直接用 vLLM 服务一个模型。

    原书第 112 页

    Example 2-18. Pod serving a locally mounted LLM via vLLM

    apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: llm-server
spec:
  containers:
  - name: main
    image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
    args:
      - "--served-model-name"
      - "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B"
      - "--model"
      - "/mnt/models"
    volumeMounts:
      - name: model-volume
        mountPath: /mnt/models
        subPath: models
  volumes:
  - name: model-volume
    image:
      reference: quay.io/meta-llama/meta-llama-3.2-8b
      pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    • Runtime image for serving the model, vLLM in this case.用于服务模型的运行时镜像，本例为 vLLM。
    • Specify an absolute path to the mounted model as a startup argument for vLLM.把挂载模型的绝对路径作为 vLLM 的启动参数指定。
    • Mount the content of the OCI image into /mnt/models.把 OCI 镜像的内容挂载到 /mnt/models。
    • The subPath field mounts only a specific subdirectory from the image rather than the entire image root. Using models as the subPath matches the typical modelcar image structure and provides forward compatibility.subPath 字段只挂载镜像中的某个子目录，而非整个镜像根。以 models 作为 subPath 与典型的 modelcar 镜像结构一致，并提供前向兼容。
    • image: is the volume type for an OCI image to mount. The usual pull semantics for images apply: if no pullPolicy is provided, always pull the image if the tag latest is specified. Otherwise, Kubernetes pulls only if the image is not present at the node.image: 是要挂载的 OCI 镜像的卷类型。适用常规的镜像拉取语义：若未提供 pullPolicy，且指定了 latest 标签，则总是拉取镜像；否则 Kubernetes 仅在节点上不存在该镜像时才拉取。
    • The pull policy can be also specified explicitly.拉取策略也可显式指定。

    Image volumes support subPath and subPathExpr mounts, allowing you to mount specific subdirectories from an OCI image rather than the entire image root. The subPath feature is particularly important for forward compatibility with modelcars (see “Modelcars” on page 68). By structuring your OCI images with model data in a /models subdirectory and using subPath: models, you create images that work

    镜像卷支持 subPath 与 subPathExpr 挂载，让你能挂载 OCI 镜像中的特定子目录，而非整个镜像根。subPath 特性对于与 modelcar（见第 68 页“Modelcars”）的前向兼容尤为重要。把 OCI 镜像结构设计为模型数据放在 /models 子目录、并使用 subPath: models，你创建的镜像就能

    原书第 113 页

    seamlessly with both the modelcar approach and native OCI image volumes. This enables a smooth migration path from modelcars to native image volumes without rebuilding your model images.

    同时顺畅地配合 modelcar 方式与原生 OCI 镜像卷。这提供了一条从 modelcar 平滑迁移到原生镜像卷的路径，而无需重建模型镜像。

    While this image volume mount feature simplifies large model deployments for both OCI images and OCI artifacts, it still has limitations as of early 2026:

    虽然这种镜像卷挂载特性简化了 OCI 镜像与 OCI artifacts 的大模型部署，但截至 2026 年初仍有局限：

  • Container runtime support: CRI-O v1.33+ has full support; containerd requires v2.2.0+ for beta features (v2.1.0+ for basic support).容器运行时支持：CRI-O v1.33+ 已完整支持；containerd 需 v2.2.0+ 才能用 beta 特性（v2.1.0+ 支持基础能力）。
  • Feature gates must be explicitly enabled (still disabled by default).Feature gate 必须显式启用（默认仍关闭）。
  • The feature doesn’t support writeable layers; volumes remain read-only.该特性不支持可写层；卷保持只读。
  • Only directory mounts are supported; individual files cannot be mounted directly.只支持目录挂载；无法直接挂载单个文件。

    • The community is actively working on these limitations, with signature validation, compressed layers, and read-write support planned for future releases. This feature will eventually become the preferred method for serving LLMs on Kubernetes, replacing the modelcar approach as it matures. In the meantime, modelcars are a reliable approach for direct access to model data stored in an OCI image.

    社区正积极解决这些局限，签名校验、压缩层、可读写支持都已列入未来版本计划。随着成熟，这一特性最终会成为在 Kubernetes 上服务 LLM 的首选方式，取代 modelcar 方式。在此期间，modelcar 是直接访问 OCI 镜像中模型数据的可靠方案。

    Lessons Learned
    本章小结

    In this chapter we explored how to package, store, and access model data in Kubernetes, from storage formats to deployment strategies.

    本章探讨了如何在 Kubernetes 中打包、存储与访问模型数据，从存储格式到部署策略。

    Model data access strategies involve fundamental trade-offs among storage efficiency, access performance, and operational complexity. Table 2-3 summarizes the key characteristics of each approach.

    模型数据访问策略在存储效率、访问性能与运维复杂度之间存在根本权衡。表 2-3 总结了各种方式的关键特征。

    Init container copying delivers the fastest inference performance through node-local I/O, making it ideal for latency-sensitive workloads. However, this approach wastes storage when running multiple replicas, as each node maintains its own copy. Use this strategy for single-replica or low-concurrency scenarios where you can tolerate slow startup in exchange for peak inference performance.

    Init 容器复制通过节点本地 I/O 提供最快的推理性能，非常适合延迟敏感的负载。但这种方式在运行多副本时浪费存储，因为每个节点都维护自己的一份副本。在单副本或低并发场景中使用此策略——你可以容忍较慢启动，以换取峰值推理性能。

    PersistentVolumes provide the highest storage efficiency by storing models once and sharing them across all replicas. Storage efficiency comes at the cost of network latency on every model file read. PVs work well for tens of replicas but face challenges when scaling to hundreds due to backend saturation and network contention. Choose PVs when storage costs matter more than peak inference performance, or when data scientists manage models externally through distributed filesystems.

    PersistentVolume 通过把模型存一次、跨所有副本共享，提供最高存储效率。存储效率的代价是每次读模型文件都有网络延迟。PV 对几十个副本很适用，但扩到几百个时会因后端饱和与网络竞争而吃力。当存储成本比峰值推理性能更重要、或数据科学家通过分布式文件系统在外部管理模型时，选择 PV。

    OCI image-based approaches (modelcars and volume mounts) offer a middle ground: high storage efficiency through layer sharing plus fast local access. As a standardized format, OCI enables seamless model distribution and discovery across registries. Modelcars provide immediate availability but require process namespace sharing with security considerations. OCI volume mounts offer cleaner integration as a native Kubernetes feature but remain experimental as of Kubernetes 1.33. Both approaches excel when running multiple fine-tuned models sharing the same base model, as common layers are shared across all instances.

    基于 OCI 镜像的方式（modelcar 与卷挂载）提供了中间路线：通过层共享获得高存储效率，又有快速本地访问。作为标准化格式，OCI 支持跨注册表无缝分发与发现模型。Modelcar 立即可用，但需要共享进程命名空间并考虑安全。OCI 卷挂载作为 Kubernetes 原生特性集成更干净，但截至 Kubernetes 1.33 仍在实验阶段。当运行多个共享同一基础模型的微调模型时，这两种方式都表现出色——因为公共层在所有实例间共享。

    Consider hybrid strategies for complex environments. Development environments might use PersistentVolumes for easy model updates, while production deployments use OCI volumes for performance and reliability. Different model tiers might use different approaches: frequently accessed models in OCI images for speed and less-critical models sharing PersistentVolumes for cost efficiency. As OCI volume mounts mature and gain widespread runtime support, they will likely become the preferred approach for most deployments.

    对复杂环境，考虑混合策略。开发环境可用 PersistentVolume 以便模型更新，生产部署则用 OCI 卷以获得性能与可靠性。不同模型层级可用不同方式：高频访问的模型放 OCI 镜像以求速度，次要模型共享 PersistentVolume 以求成本效率。随着 OCI 卷挂载成熟并获得广泛运行时支持，它很可能成为大多数部署的首选方式。

    This concludes Part I. You now have the foundation for deploying LLMs on Kubernetes: serving runtimes, lifecycle controllers, and strategies for managing model data. The next part builds on this foundation, addressing what it takes to run inference workloads in production, from GPU management to scaling and observability.

    第一部分到此结束。你已经掌握了在 Kubernetes 上部署 LLM 的基础：服务运行时、生命周期控制器、以及管理模型数据的策略。下一部分在此基础上，讨论在生产中运行推理负载所需的一切——从 GPU 管理到扩缩容与可观测性。

    PART II

    Production Readiness

    第二部分　生产就绪

    Production readiness means a model can handle sustained traffic without surprises. This part examines the operational work that follows the first successful deployment. It opens by explaining how schedulers, device plug-ins, and resource limits shape throughput and utilization of GPUs. Next, the pieces are tied together with scaling policies, rollout strategies, and failure handling. The concluding chapter shows how logs, metrics, and traces reveal latency, accuracy, and cost information. The aim is to keep performance steady and costs under control as demand grows.

    生产就绪意味着模型能在持续流量下稳定运行而不出意外。本部分考察首次成功部署之后的运维工作。开篇解释调度器、设备插件与资源限制如何塑造 GPU 的吞吐与利用率；接着用扩缩容策略、发布策略与故障处理把各部分串起来；收尾章节展示日志、指标与追踪如何揭示延迟、精度与成本信息。目标是在需求增长时保持性能稳定、成本可控。

    In detail, the chapters in this part cover the following aspects:

    具体而言，本部分各章涵盖以下方面：

  • Chapter 3, “Kubernetes and GPUs”, describes how Kubernetes and GPUs can work well together.第 3 章《Kubernetes 与 GPU》介绍 Kubernetes 与 GPU 如何良好协作。
  • Chapter 4, “Running in Production”, focuses on the optimization of the model/runtime for production workload.第 4 章《生产运行》聚焦面向生产负载的模型/运行时优化。
  • Chapter 5, “Model Observability”, explains the specific observability aspects that make model observability slightly different compared to traditional workload observability on Kubernetes.第 5 章《模型可观测性》解释模型可观测性相较 Kubernetes 上传统负载可观测性的特殊之处。
